en_swarupananda: Let him firmly hold his body, head and neck erect and still, (with the eye-balls fixed, as if) gazing at the tip of his nose, and not looking around.

speaker: krishna
sa:
प्रशान्तात्मा विगतभीर्ब्रह्मचारिव्रते स्थितः ।
मनः संयम्य मच्चित्तो युक्त आसीत मत्परः ॥
sa_padas: मनः संयम्य मच्चित्तो युक्त आसीत मत्परः
iast_lib:
praśāntātmā vigatabhīrbrahmacārivrate sthitaḥ |
manaḥ saṃyamya maccitto yukta āsīta matparaḥ ||
en: The self serene, fearless, firm in the vow of the Brahmachâri, the mind controlled, thinking on Me, harmonised, let him sit aspiring after Me.
en_source: Besant 1922 (4th ed.) via en.wikisource [second-hand copy: Gita.AI]
en_swarupananda: With the heart serene and fearless, firm in the vow of a Brahmachâri, with the mind controlled, and ever thinking of Me, let him sit (in Yoga) having Me as his supreme goal.

speaker: krishna
sa:
युञ्जन्नेवं सदाऽऽत्मानं योगी नियतमानसः ।
शान्तिं निर्वाणपरमां मत्संस्थामधिगच्छति ॥
iast_lib:
yuñjannevaṃ sadā''tmānaṃ yogī niyatamānasaḥ |
śāntiṃ nirvāṇaparamāṃ matsaṃsthāmadhigacchati ||
en: The Yogî ever united thus with the Self, with the mind controlled, goeth to Peace, to the supreme Bliss that abideth in Me.
en_source: Besant 1922 (4th ed.) via en.wikisource [second-hand copy: Gita.AI]
en_swarupananda: Thus always keeping the mind steadfast, the Yogi of subdued mind attains the peace residing in Me,—the peace which culminates in Nirvâna (Moksha).

speaker: krishna
sa:
नात्यश्नतस्तु योगोऽस्ति न चैकान्तमनश्नतः ।
न चातिस्वप्नशीलस्य जाग्रतो नैव चार्जुन ॥
iast_lib:
nātyaśnatastu yogo'sti na caikāntamanaśnataḥ |
na cātisvapnaśīlasya jāgrato naiva cārjuna ||
en: Verily yoga is not for him who eateth too much, nor who abstaineth to excess, nor who is too much addicted to sleep, nor even to wakefulness, O Arjuna.
en_source: Besant 1922 (4th ed.) via en.wikisource [second-hand copy: Gita.AI]
en_swarupananda: (Success in) Yoga is not for him who eats too much or too little—nor, O Arjuna, for him who sleeps too much or too little.

speaker: krishna
sa:
युक्ताहारविहारस्य युक्तचेष्टस्य कर्मसु ।
युक्तस्वप्नावबोधस्य योगो भवति दुःखहा ॥
iast_lib:
yuktāhāravihārasya yuktaceṣṭasya karmasu |
yuktasvapnāvabodhasya yogo bhavati duḥkhahā ||
en: Yoga killeth out all pain for him who is regulated in eating and amusement, regulated in performing actions, regulated in sleeping and waking.
en_source: Besant 1922 (4th ed.) via en.wikisource [second-hand copy: Gita.AI]
en_swarupananda: To him who is temperate in eating and recreation, in his effort for work, and in sleep and wakefulness, Yoga becomes the destroyer of misery.

speaker: krishna
sa:
यदा विनियतं चित्तमात्मन्येवावतिष्ठते ।
निःस्पृहः सर्वकामेभ्यो युक्त इत्युच्यते तदा ॥
iast_lib:
yadā viniyataṃ cittamātmanyevāvatiṣṭhate |
niḥspṛhaḥ sarvakāmebhyo yukta ityucyate tadā ||
en: When his subdued thought is fixed on the Self, free from longing after all desirable things, then it is said, "he is harmonised."
en_source: Besant 1922 (4th ed.) via en.wikisource [second-hand copy: Gita.AI]
en_swarupananda: When the completely controlled mind rests serenely in the Self alone, free from longing after all desires, then is one called steadfast, (in the Self).

speaker: krishna
sa:
यथा दीपो निवातस्थो नेङ्गते सोपमा स्मृता ।
योगिनो यतचित्तस्य युञ्जतो योगमात्मनः ॥
sa_padas: यथा दीपो निवातस्थो नेङ्गते सोपमा स्मृता
iast_lib:
yathā dīpo nivātastho neṅgate sopamā smṛtā |
yogino yatacittasya yuñjato yogamātmanaḥ ||
en: As a lamp in a windless place flickereth not, to such is likened the Yogî of subdued thought, absorbed in the yoga of the Self.
en_source: Besant 1922 (4th ed.) via en.wikisource [second-hand copy: Gita.AI]
en_swarupananda: "As a lamp in a spot sheltered from the wind does not flicker,"—even such has been the simile used for a Yogi of subdued mind, practising concentration in the Self.

speaker: krishna
sa:
यत्रोपरमते चित्तं निरुद्धं योगसेवया ।
यत्र चैवात्मनाऽऽत्मानं पश्यन्नात्मनि तुष्यति ॥
iast_lib:
yatroparamate cittaṃ niruddhaṃ yogasevayā |
yatra caivātmanā''tmānaṃ paśyannātmani tuṣyati ||
en: That in which the mind finds rest, quieted by the practice of yoga: that in which he, seeing the Self by the Self, in the Self is satisfied;
en_source: Besant 1922 (4th ed.) via en.wikisource [second-hand copy: Gita.AI]
en_swarupananda: When the mind, absolutely restrained by the practice of concentration, attains quietude, and when seeing the Self by the self, one is satisfied in his own Self; when he feels that infinite bliss—which is perceived by the (purified) intellect and which transcends the senses, and established wherein he never departs from his real state; and having obtained which, regards no other acquisition superior to that, and where established, he is not moved even by heavy sorrow;—let that be known as the state, called by the name of Yoga,—a state of severance from the contact of pain. This Yoga should be practised with perseverance, undisturbed by depression of heart.

speaker: krishna
sa:
सुखमात्यन्तिकं यत्तद्बुद्धिग्राह्यमतीन्द्रियम् ।
वेत्ति यत्र न चैवायं स्थितश्चलति तत्त्वतः ॥
sa_padas: वेत्ति यत्र न चैवायं स्थितश्चलति तत्त्वतः
iast_lib:
sukhamātyantikaṃ yattadbuddhigrāhyamatīndriyam |
vetti yatra na caivāyaṃ sthitaścalati tattvataḥ ||
en: That in which he findeth the supreme delight which the Reason can grasp beyond the senses, wherein established he moveth not from the Reality;
en_source: Besant 1922 (4th ed.) via en.wikisource [second-hand copy: Gita.AI]
en_swarupananda: When the mind, absolutely restrained by the practice of concentration, attains quietude, and when seeing the Self by the self, one is satisfied in his own Self; when he feels that infinite bliss—which is perceived by the (purified) intellect and which transcends the senses, and established wherein he never departs from his real state; and having obtained which, regards no other acquisition superior to that, and where established, he is not moved even by heavy sorrow;—let that be known as the state, called by the name of Yoga,—a state of severance from the contact of pain. This Yoga should be practised with perseverance, undisturbed by depression of heart.

speaker: krishna
sa:
यं लब्ध्वा चापरं लाभं मन्यते नाधिकं ततः ।
यस्मिन्स्थितो न दुःखेन गुरुणापि विचाल्यते ॥
sa_padas: यं लब्ध्वा चापरं लाभं मन्यते नाधिकं ततः
iast_lib:
yaṃ labdhvā cāparaṃ lābhaṃ manyate nādhikaṃ tataḥ |
yasminsthito na duḥkhena guruṇāpi vicālyate ||
en: Which, having obtained, he thinketh there is no greater gain beyond it; wherein, established, he is not shaken even by heavy sorrow;
en_source: Besant 1922 (4th ed.) via en.wikisource [second-hand copy: Gita.AI]
en_swarupananda: When the mind, absolutely restrained by the practice of concentration, attains quietude, and when seeing the Self by the self, one is satisfied in his own Self; when he feels that infinite bliss—which is perceived by the (purified) intellect and which transcends the senses, and established wherein he never departs from his real state; and having obtained which, regards no other acquisition superior to that, and where established, he is not moved even by heavy sorrow;—let that be known as the state, called by the name of Yoga,—a state of severance from the contact of pain. This Yoga should be practised with perseverance, undisturbed by depression of heart.

speaker: krishna
sa:
तं विद्याद् दुःखसंयोगवियोगं योगसंज्ञितम् ।
स निश्चयेन योक्तव्यो योगोऽनिर्विण्णचेतसा ॥
iast_lib:
taṃ vidyād duḥkhasaṃyogaviyogaṃ yogasaṃjñitam |
sa niścayena yoktavyo yogo'nirviṇṇacetasā ||
en: That should be known by the name of yoga, this disconnection from the union with pain. This yoga must be clung to with a firm conviction and with undesponding mind.
en_source: Besant 1922 (4th ed.) via en.wikisource [second-hand copy: Gita.AI]
en_swarupananda: When the mind, absolutely restrained by the practice of concentration, attains quietude, and when seeing the Self by the self, one is satisfied in his own Self; when he feels that infinite bliss—which is perceived by the (purified) intellect and which transcends the senses, and established wherein he never departs from his real state; and having obtained which, regards no other acquisition superior to that, and where established, he is not moved even by heavy sorrow;—let that be known as the state, called by the name of Yoga,—a state of severance from the contact of pain. This Yoga should be practised with perseverance, undisturbed by depression of heart.

speaker: krishna
sa:
सङ्कल्पप्रभवान्कामांस्त्यक्त्वा सर्वानशेषतः ।
मनसैवेन्द्रियग्रामं विनियम्य समन्ततः ॥
iast_lib:
saṅkalpaprabhavānkāmāṃstyaktvā sarvānaśeṣataḥ |
manasaivendriyagrāmaṃ viniyamya samantataḥ ||
en: Abandoning without reserve all desires born of the imagination, by the mind curbing in the aggregate of the senses on every side,
en_source: Besant 1922 (4th ed.) via en.wikisource [second-hand copy: Gita.AI]
en_swarupananda: Abandoning without reserve all desires born of Sankalpa, and completely restraining, by the mind alone, the whole group of senses from their objects in all directions;

speaker: krishna
sa:
शनैः शनैरुपरमेद् बुद्ध्या धृतिगृहीतया ।
आत्मसंस्थं मनः कृत्वा न किञ्चिदपि चिन्तयेत् ॥
sa_padas: आत्मसंस्थं मनः कृत्वा न किञ्चिदपि चिन्तयेत्
iast_lib:
śanaiḥ śanairuparamed buddhyā dhṛtigṛhītayā |
ātmasaṃsthaṃ manaḥ kṛtvā na kiñcidapi cintayet ||
en: Little by little let him gain tranquillity, by means of Reason controlled by steadiness; having made the mind abide in the Self, let him not think of anything.
en_source: Besant 1922 (4th ed.) via en.wikisource [second-hand copy: Gita.AI]
en_swarupananda: With the intellect set in patience, with the mind fastened on the Self, let him attain quietude by degrees: let him not think of anything.

speaker: krishna
sa:
यतो यतो निश्चरति मनश्चञ्चलमस्थिरम् ।
ततस्ततो नियम्यैतदात्मन्येव वशं नयेत् ॥
iast_lib:
yato yato niścarati manaścañcalamasthiram |
tatastato niyamyaitadātmanyeva vaśaṃ nayet ||
en: As often as the wavering and unsteady mind goeth forth, so often reining it in, let him bring it under the control of the Self.
en_source: Besant 1922 (4th ed.) via en.wikisource [second-hand copy: Gita.AI]
en_swarupananda: Through whatever reason the restless, unsteady mind wanders away, let him curbing it from that, bring it under the subjugation of the Self alone.

speaker: krishna
sa:
प्रशान्तमनसं ह्येनं योगिनं सुखमुत्तमम् ।
उपैति शान्तरजसं ब्रह्मभूतमकल्मषम् ॥
iast_lib:
praśāntamanasaṃ hyenaṃ yoginaṃ sukhamuttamam |
upaiti śāntarajasaṃ brahmabhūtamakalmaṣam ||
en: Supreme joy is for this Yogi whose mind is peaceful, whose passion-nature is calmed, who is sinless and of the nature of the Eternal.
en_source: Besant 1922 (4th ed.) via en.wikisource [second-hand copy: Gita.AI]
en_swarupananda: Verily, the supreme bliss comes to that Yogi, of perfectly tranquil mind, with passions quieted, Brahman-become, and freed from taint.

speaker: krishna
sa:
युञ्जन्नेवं सदाऽऽत्मानं योगी विगतकल्मषः ।
सुखेन ब्रह्मसंस्पर्शमत्यन्तं सुखमश्नुते ॥
iast_lib:
yuñjannevaṃ sadā''tmānaṃ yogī vigatakalmaṣaḥ |
sukhena brahmasaṃsparśamatyantaṃ sukhamaśnute ||
en: The Yogî who thus, ever harmonising the self, hath put away sin, he easily enjoyeth the infinite bliss of contact with the Eternal.
en_source: Besant 1922 (4th ed.) via en.wikisource [second-hand copy: Gita.AI]
en_swarupananda: The Yogi freed from taint (of good and evil), constantly engaging the mind thus, with ease attains the infinite bliss of contact with Brahman.

speaker: krishna
sa:
सर्वभूतस्थमात्मानं सर्वभूतानि चात्मनि ।
ईक्षते योगयुक्तात्मा सर्वत्र समदर्शनः ॥
iast_lib:
sarvabhūtasthamātmānaṃ sarvabhūtāni cātmani |
īkṣate yogayuktātmā sarvatra samadarśanaḥ ||
en: The self, harmonised by yoga, seeth the Self abiding in all beings, all beings in the Self; everywhere he seeth the same.
en_source: Besant 1922 (4th ed.) via en.wikisource [second-hand copy: Gita.AI]
en_swarupananda: With the heart concentrated by Yoga, with the eye of evenness for all things, he beholds the Self in all beings and all beings in the Self.

speaker: krishna
sa:
यो मां पश्यति सर्वत्र सर्वं च मयि पश्यति ।
तस्याहं न प्रणश्यामि स च मे न प्रणश्यति ॥
sa_padas: यो मां पश्यति सर्वत्र सर्वं च मयि पश्यति
तस्याहं न प्रणश्यामि स च मे न प्रणश्यति
iast_lib:
yo māṃ paśyati sarvatra sarvaṃ ca mayi paśyati |
tasyāhaṃ na praṇaśyāmi sa ca me na praṇaśyati ||
en: He who seeth Me everywhere, and seeth everything in Me, of him will I never lose hold, and he shall never lose hold of Me.
en_source: Besant 1922 (4th ed.) via en.wikisource [second-hand copy: Gita.AI]
en_swarupananda: He who sees Me in all things, and sees all things in Me, he never becomes separated from Me, nor do I become separated from him.

speaker: krishna
sa:
सर्वभूतस्थितं यो मां भजत्येकत्वमास्थितः ।
सर्वथा वर्तमानोऽपि स योगी मयि वर्तते ॥
sa_padas: सर्वथा वर्तमानोऽपि स योगी मयि वर्तते
iast_lib:
sarvabhūtasthitaṃ yo māṃ bhajatyekatvamāsthitaḥ |
sarvathā vartamāno'pi sa yogī mayi vartate ||
en: He who, established in unity, worshippeth Me abiding in all beings, that Yogi liveth in Me, whatever his mode of living.
en_source: Besant 1922 (4th ed.) via en.wikisource [second-hand copy: Gita.AI]
en_swarupananda: He who being established in unity, worships Me, who am dwelling in all beings, whatever his mode of life, that Yogi abides in Me.

speaker: krishna
sa:
आत्मौपम्येन सर्वत्र समं पश्यति योऽर्जुन ।
सुखं वा यदि वा दुःखं सः योगी परमो मतः ॥
sa_padas: सुखं वा यदि वा दुःखं सः योगी परमो मतः
iast_lib:
ātmaupamyena sarvatra samaṃ paśyati yo'rjuna |
sukhaṃ vā yadi vā duḥkhaṃ saḥ yogī paramo mataḥ ||
en: He who, through the likeness of the Self, O Arjuna, seeth equality in everything, whether pleasant or painful, he is considered a perfect Yogî.
en_source: Besant 1922 (4th ed.) via en.wikisource [second-hand copy: Gita.AI]
en_swarupananda: He who judges of pleasure or pain everywhere, by the same standard as he applies to himself, that Yogi, O Arjuna, is regarded as the highest.

sa_review.why: A (base) is outvoted by agreeing independent witnesses

readings.A: आत्मौपम्येन सर्वत्र समं पश्यति योऽर्जुन सुखं वा यदि वा दुःखं सः योगी परमो मतः
readings.C: ātmaupamyena sarvatra samaṃ paśyati yorjuna sukhaṃ vā yadi vā duḥkhaṃ sa yogī paramo mataḥ
readings.D: ātmaupamyena sarvatra samaṃ paśyati yo 'rjuna sukhaṃ vā yadi vā duḥkhaṃ sa yogī paramo mataḥ
readings.V: आत्मौपम्येन सर्वत्र समं पश्यति योऽर्जुन सुखं वा यदि वा दुःखं स योगी परमो मतः

speaker: arjuna
sa:
योऽयं योगस्त्वया प्रोक्तः साम्येन मधुसूदन ।
एतस्याहं न पश्यामि चञ्चलत्वात् स्थितिं स्थिराम् ॥
sa_padas: एतस्याहं न पश्यामि चञ्चलत्वात् स्थितिं स्थिराम्
iast_lib:
yo'yaṃ yogastvayā proktaḥ sāmyena madhusūdana |
etasyāhaṃ na paśyāmi cañcalatvāt sthitiṃ sthirām ||
en: This yoga which Thou hast declared to be by equanimity, O Madhusûdana, I see not a stable foundation for it, owing to restlessness;
en_source: Besant 1922 (4th ed.) via en.wikisource [second-hand copy: Gita.AI]
en_swarupananda: This Yoga which has been taught by Thee, O slayer of Madhu, as characterised by evenness, I do not see (the possibility of) its lasting endurance, owing to restlessness (of the mind).

speaker: arjuna
sa:
चञ्चलं हि मनः कृष्ण प्रमाथि बलवद्दृढम् ।
तस्याहं निग्रहं मन्ये वायोरिव सुदुष्करम् ॥
sa_padas: चञ्चलं हि मनः कृष्ण प्रमाथि बलवद्दृढम्
iast_lib:
cañcalaṃ hi manaḥ kṛṣṇa pramāthi balavaddṛḍham |
tasyāhaṃ nigrahaṃ manye vāyoriva suduṣkaram ||
en: For the mind is verily restless, O Krishna; it is impetuous, strong and difficult to bend. I deem it as hard to curb as the wind.
en_source: Besant 1922 (4th ed.) via en.wikisource [second-hand copy: Gita.AI]
en_swarupananda: Verily, the mind, O Krishna, is restless, turbulent, strong, and unyielding;. I regard it quite as hard to achieve its control, as that of the wind.

speaker: krishna
sa:
असंशयं महाबाहो मनो दुर्निग्रहं चलं ।
अभ्यासेन तु कौन्तेय वैराग्येण च गृह्यते ॥
sa_padas: अभ्यासेन तु कौन्तेय वैराग्येण च गृह्यते
iast_lib:
asaṃśayaṃ mahābāho mano durnigrahaṃ calaṃ |
abhyāsena tu kaunteya vairāgyeṇa ca gṛhyate ||
en: The Blessed Lord said: Without doubt, O mighty-armed, the mind is hard to curb and restless; but it may be curbed by constant practice and by dispassion.
en_source: Besant 1922 (4th ed.) via en.wikisource [second-hand copy: Gita.AI]
en_swarupananda: Without doubt, O mighty-armed, the mind is restless, and difficult to control; but through practice and renunciation, O son of Kunti, it may be governed.

sa_review.why: A (base) is outvoted by agreeing independent witnesses

readings.A: असंशयं महाबाहो मनो दुर्निग्रहं चलं अभ्यासेन तु कौन्तेय वैराग्येण च गृह्यते
readings.C: asañśayaṃ mahābāho mano durnigrahaṃ calam abhyāsena tu kaunteya vairāgyeṇa ca gṛhyate
readings.D: asaṃśayaṃ mahābāho mano durnigrahaṃ calam abhyāsena tu kaunteya vairāgyeṇa ca gṛhyate
readings.V: असंशयं महाबाहो मनो दुर्निग्रहं चलम् अभ्यासेन तु कौन्तेय वैराग्येण च गृह्यते

speaker: krishna
sa:
असंयतात्मना योगो दुष्प्राप इति मे मतिः ।
वश्यात्मना तु यतता शक्योऽवाप्तुमुपायतः ॥
sa_padas: असंयतात्मना योगो दुष्प्राप इति मे मतिः
iast_lib:
asaṃyatātmanā yogo duṣprāpa iti me matiḥ |
vaśyātmanā tu yatatā śakyo'vāptumupāyataḥ ||
en: Yoga is hard to attain, methinks, by a self that is uncontrolled; but by the Self -controlled it is attainable by properly directed energy.
en_source: Besant 1922 (4th ed.) via en.wikisource [second-hand copy: Gita.AI]
en_swarupananda: Yoga is hard to be attained by one of uncontrolled self: such is My conviction; but the self-controlled, striving by right means, can obtain it.

speaker: arjuna
sa:
अयतिः श्रद्धयोपेतो योगाच्चलितमानसः ।
अप्राप्य योगसंसिद्धिं कां गतिं कृष्ण गच्छति ॥
sa_padas: अप्राप्य योगसंसिद्धिं कां गतिं कृष्ण गच्छति
iast_lib:
ayatiḥ śraddhayopeto yogāccalitamānasaḥ |
aprāpya yogasaṃsiddhiṃ kāṃ gatiṃ kṛṣṇa gacchati ||
en: Arjuna said: He who is unsubdued but who possesseth faith, with the mind wandering away from yoga, failing to attain perfection in yoga, what path doth he tread, O Krishna?
en_source: Besant 1922 (4th ed.) via en.wikisource [second-hand copy: Gita.AI]
en_swarupananda: Though possessed of Shraddhâ but unable to control himself, with the mind wandering away from Yoga, what end does one, failing to gain perfection in Yoga, meet, O Krishna?

speaker: arjuna
sa:
कच्चिन्नोभयविभ्रष्टश्छिन्नाभ्रमिव नश्यति ।
अप्रतिष्ठो महाबाहो विमूढो ब्रह्मणः पथि ॥
iast_lib:
kaccinnobhayavibhraṣṭaśchinnābhramiva naśyati |
apratiṣṭho mahābāho vimūḍho brahmaṇaḥ pathi ||
en: Fallen from both, is he destroyed like a rent cloud, unsteadfast, O mighty-armed, deluded in the path of the Eternal?
en_source: Besant 1922 (4th ed.) via en.wikisource [second-hand copy: Gita.AI]
en_swarupananda: Does he not, fallen from both, perish, without support, like a rent cloud, O mighty-armed, deluded in the path of Brahman?

speaker: arjuna
sa:
एतन्मे संशयं कृष्ण छेत्तुमर्हस्यशेषतः ।
त्वदन्यः संशयस्यास्य छेत्ता न ह्युपपद्यते ॥
iast_lib:
etanme saṃśayaṃ kṛṣṇa chettumarhasyaśeṣataḥ |
tvadanyaḥ saṃśayasyāsya chettā na hyupapadyate ||
en: Deign, O Krishna, to completely dispel this doubt of mine; for there is none to be found save Thyself able to destroy this doubt.
en_source: Besant 1922 (4th ed.) via en.wikisource [second-hand copy: Gita.AI]
en_swarupananda: This doubt of mine, O Krishna, Thou shouldst completely dispel; for it is not possible for any but Thee to dispel this doubt.

speaker: krishna
sa:
पार्थ नैवेह नामुत्र विनाशस्तस्य विद्यते ।
नहि कल्याणकृत्कश्चिद्दुर्गतिं तात गच्छति ॥
iast_lib:
pārtha naiveha nāmutra vināśastasya vidyate |
nahi kalyāṇakṛtkaściddurgatiṃ tāta gacchati ||
en: The Blessed Lord said: O son of Prithâ, neither in this world nor in the life to come is there destruction for him; never doth any who worketh righteousness, O beloved, tread the path of woe.
en_source: Besant 1922 (4th ed.) via en.wikisource [second-hand copy: Gita.AI]
en_swarupananda: Verily, O son of Prithâ, there is destruction for him, neither here nor hereafter: for, the doer of good, O my son, never comes to grief.

speaker: krishna
sa:
प्राप्य पुण्यकृतां लोकानुषित्वा शाश्वतीः समाः ।
शुचीनां श्रीमतां गेहे योगभ्रष्टोऽभिजायते ॥
iast_lib:
prāpya puṇyakṛtāṃ lokānuṣitvā śāśvatīḥ samāḥ |
śucīnāṃ śrīmatāṃ gehe yogabhraṣṭo'bhijāyate ||
en: Having attained to the worlds of the pure-doing, and having dwelt there for immemorial years, he who fell from yoga is reborn in a pure and blessed house;
en_source: Besant 1922 (4th ed.) via en.wikisource [second-hand copy: Gita.AI]
en_swarupananda: Having attained to the worlds of the righteous, and dwelling there for everlasting years, one fallen from Yoga reincarnates in the home of the pure and the prosperous.

speaker: krishna
sa:
अथवा योगिनामेव कुले भवति धीमताम् ।
एतद्धि दुर्लभतरं लोके जन्म यदीदृशम् ॥
iast_lib:
athavā yogināmeva kule bhavati dhīmatām |
etaddhi durlabhataraṃ loke janma yadīdṛśam ||
en: Or he may even be born into a family of wise Yogîs; but such a birth as that is most difficult to obtain in this world.
en_source: Besant 1922 (4th ed.) via en.wikisource [second-hand copy: Gita.AI]
en_swarupananda: Or else he is born into a family of wise Yogis only; verily, a birth such as that is very rare to obtain in this world.

speaker: krishna
sa:
तत्र तं बुद्धिसंयोगं लभते पौर्वदेहिकम् ।
यतते च ततो भूयः संसिद्धौ कुरुनन्दन ॥
sa_padas: यतते च ततो भूयः संसिद्धौ कुरुनन्दन
iast_lib:
tatra taṃ buddhisaṃyogaṃ labhate paurvadehikam |
yatate ca tato bhūyaḥ saṃsiddhau kurunandana ||
en: There he recovereth the characteristics belonging to this former body, and with these he again laboureth for perfection, O joy of the Kurus.
en_source: Besant 1922 (4th ed.) via en.wikisource [second-hand copy: Gita.AI]
en_swarupananda: There he is united with the intelligence acquired in his former body, and strives more than before, for perfection, O son of the Kurus.

speaker: krishna
sa:
पूर्वाभ्यासेन तेनैव ह्रियते ह्यवशोऽपि सः ।
जिज्ञासुरपि योगस्य शब्दब्रह्मातिवर्तते ॥
iast_lib:
pūrvābhyāsena tenaiva hriyate hyavaśo'pi saḥ |
jijñāsurapi yogasya śabdabrahmātivartate ||
en: By that former practice he is irresistibly swept away. Only wishing to know yoga, even the seeker after yoga goeth beyond the Brâhmic world;
en_source: Besant 1922 (4th ed.) via en.wikisource [second-hand copy: Gita.AI]
en_swarupananda: By that previous practice alone, he is borne on in spite of himself. Even the enquirer after Yoga rises superior to the performer of Vedic actions.

speaker: krishna
sa:
प्रयत्नाद्यतमानस्तु योगी संशुद्धकिल्बिषः ।
अनेकजन्मसंसिद्धस्ततो याति परां गतिम् ॥
iast_lib:
prayatnādyatamānastu yogī saṃśuddhakilbiṣaḥ |
anekajanmasaṃsiddhastato yāti parāṃ gatim ||
en: But the Yogî, labouring with assiduity, purified from sin, fully perfected through manifold births, he reacheth the supreme goal.
en_source: Besant 1922 (4th ed.) via en.wikisource [second-hand copy: Gita.AI]
en_swarupananda: The Yogi, striving assiduously, purified of taint, gradually gaining perfection through many births, then reaches the highest goal.

speaker: krishna
sa:
तपस्विभ्योऽधिको योगी ज्ञानिभ्योऽपि मतोऽधिकः ।
कर्मिभ्यश्चाधिको योगी तस्माद्योगी भवार्जुन ॥
iast_lib:
tapasvibhyo'dhiko yogī jñānibhyo'pi mato'dhikaḥ |
karmibhyaścādhiko yogī tasmādyogī bhavārjuna ||
en: The Yogî is greater than the ascetics; he is thought to be greater than even the wise; the Yogî is greater than the men of action; therefore become thou a Yogî, O Arjuna!
en_source: Besant 1922 (4th ed.) via en.wikisource [second-hand copy: Gita.AI]
en_swarupananda: The Yogi is regarded as superior to those who practise asceticism, also to those who have obtained wisdom (through the Shâstras). He is also superior to the performers of action, (enjoined in the Vedas). Therefore, be thou a Yogi, O Arjuna!

speaker: krishna
sa:
योगिनामपि सर्वेषां मद्गतेनान्तरात्मना ।
श्रद्धावान्भजते यो मां स मे युक्ततमो मतः ॥
sa_padas: श्रद्धावान्भजते यो मां स मे युक्ततमो मतः
iast_lib:
yogināmapi sarveṣāṃ madgatenāntarātmanā |
śraddhāvānbhajate yo māṃ sa me yuktatamo mataḥ ||
en: And among all Yogîs, he who, full of faith, with the inner Self abiding in Me, adoreth Me, he is considered by Me to be the most completely harmonised.
en_source: Besant 1922 (4th ed.) via en.wikisource [second-hand copy: Gita.AI]
en_swarupananda: And of all Yogis, he who with the inner self merged in Me, with Shraddhâ devotes himself to Me, is considered by Me the most steadfast.

speaker: krishna
sa:
मय्यासक्तमनाः पार्थ योगं युञ्जन्मदाश्रयः ।
असंशयं समग्रं मां यथा ज्ञास्यसि तच्छृणु ॥
sa_padas: असंशयं समग्रं मां यथा ज्ञास्यसि तच्छृणु
iast_lib:
mayyāsaktamanāḥ pārtha yogaṃ yuñjanmadāśrayaḥ |
asaṃśayaṃ samagraṃ māṃ yathā jñāsyasi tacchṛṇu ||
en: The Blessed Lord said: With the mind clinging to me, O Pârtha, performing yoga, refuged in Me, how thou shalt without doubt know Me to the uttermost, that hear thou.
en_source: Besant 1922 (4th ed.) via en.wikisource [second-hand copy: Gita.AI]
en_swarupananda: With the mind intent on Me, O son of Prithâ, taking refuge in Me, and practising Yoga, how thou shalt without doubt know Me fully, that do thou hear.

speaker: krishna
sa:
ज्ञानं तेऽहं सविज्ञानमिदं वक्ष्याम्यशेषतः ।
यज्ज्ञात्वा नेह भूयोऽन्यज्ज्ञातव्यमवशिष्यते ॥
iast_lib:
jñānaṃ te'haṃ savijñānamidaṃ vakṣyāmyaśeṣataḥ |
yajjñātvā neha bhūyo'nyajjñātavyamavaśiṣyate ||
en: I will declare to thee this knowledge and wisdom in its completeness, which, having known, there is nothing more here needeth to be known.
en_source: Besant 1922 (4th ed.) via en.wikisource [second-hand copy: Gita.AI]
en_swarupananda: I shall tell you in full, of knowledge, speculative and practical, knowing which, nothing more here remains to be known.

speaker: krishna
sa:
मनुष्याणां सहस्रेषु कश्चिद्यतति सिद्धये ।
यततामपि सिद्धानां कश्चिन्मां वेत्ति तत्त्वतः ॥
iast_lib:
manuṣyāṇāṃ sahasreṣu kaścidyatati siddhaye |
yatatāmapi siddhānāṃ kaścinmāṃ vetti tattvataḥ ||
en: Among thousands of men scarce one striveth for perfection; of the successful strivers scarce one knoweth Me in essence.
en_source: Besant 1922 (4th ed.) via en.wikisource [second-hand copy: Gita.AI]
en_swarupananda: One, perchance, in thousands of men, strives for perfection; and one perchance, among the blessed ones, striving thus, knows Me in reality.

speaker: krishna
sa:
भूमिरापोऽनलो वायुः खं मनो बुद्धिरेव च ।
अहङ्कार इतीयं मे भिन्ना प्रकृतिरष्टधा ॥
sa_padas: भूमिरापोऽनलो वायुः खं मनो बुद्धिरेव च
iast_lib:
bhūmirāpo'nalo vāyuḥ khaṃ mano buddhireva ca |
ahaṅkāra itīyaṃ me bhinnā prakṛtiraṣṭadhā ||
en: Earth, water, fire, air, ether, Mind, and Reason also and Egoism—these are the eightfold division of My nature.
en_source: Besant 1922 (4th ed.) via en.wikisource [second-hand copy: Gita.AI]
en_swarupananda: Bhumi (earth), Ap (water), Anala (fire), Vâyu (air), Kha (ether), mind, intellect, and egoism: thus is My Prakriti divided eight-fold.

speaker: krishna
sa:
अपरेयमितस्त्वन्यां प्रकृतिं विद्धि मे पराम् ।
जीवभूतां महाबाहो ययेदं धार्यते जगत् ॥
iast_lib:
apareyamitastvanyāṃ prakṛtiṃ viddhi me parām |
jīvabhūtāṃ mahābāho yayedaṃ dhāryate jagat ||
en: This the inferior. Know My other nature, the higher, the life-element, O mighty-armed, by which the universe is upheld.
en_source: Besant 1922 (4th ed.) via en.wikisource [second-hand copy: Gita.AI]
en_swarupananda: This is the lower (Prakriti). But different from it, know thou, O mighty-armed, My higher Prakriti—the principle of self-consciousness, by which this universe is sustained.

speaker: krishna
sa:
एतद्योनीनि भूतानि सर्वाणीत्युपधारय ।
अहं कृत्स्नस्य जगतः प्रभवः प्रलयस्तथा ॥
iast_lib:
etadyonīni bhūtāni sarvāṇītyupadhāraya |
ahaṃ kṛtsnasya jagataḥ prabhavaḥ pralayastathā ||
en: Know this to be the womb of all beings. I am the source of the forthgoing of the whole universe and likewise the place of its dissolving.
en_source: Besant 1922 (4th ed.) via en.wikisource [second-hand copy: Gita.AI]
en_swarupananda: Know that these (two Prakritis) are the womb of all beings. I am the origin and dissolution of the whole universe.

speaker: krishna
sa:
मत्तः परतरं नान्यत्किञ्चिदस्ति धनञ्जय ।
मयि सर्वमिदं प्रोतं सूत्रे मणिगणा इव ॥
sa_padas: मयि सर्वमिदं प्रोतं सूत्रे मणिगणा इव
iast_lib:
mattaḥ parataraṃ nānyatkiñcidasti dhanañjaya |
mayi sarvamidaṃ protaṃ sūtre maṇigaṇā iva ||
en: There is naught whatsoever higher than I, O Dhananjaya. All this is threaded on Me, as rows of pearls on a string.
en_source: Besant 1922 (4th ed.) via en.wikisource [second-hand copy: Gita.AI]
en_swarupananda: Beyond Me, O Dhananjaya, there is naught. All this is strung in Me, as a row of jewels on a thread.

speaker: krishna
sa:
रसोऽहमप्सु कौन्तेय प्रभास्मि शशिसूर्ययोः ।
प्रणवः सर्ववेदेषु शब्दः खे पौरुषं नृषु ॥
sa_padas: प्रणवः सर्ववेदेषु शब्दः खे पौरुषं नृषु
iast_lib:
raso'hamapsu kaunteya prabhāsmi śaśisūryayoḥ |
praṇavaḥ sarvavedeṣu śabdaḥ khe pauruṣaṃ nṛṣu ||
en: I the sapidity in waters, O son of Kuntî, I the radiance in moon and sun; the Word of Power in all the Vedas, sound in ether, and virility in men;
en_source: Besant 1922 (4th ed.) via en.wikisource [second-hand copy: Gita.AI]
en_swarupananda: I am the sapidity in waters, O son of Kunti; I, the radiance in the moon and the sun; I am the Om in all the Vedas, sound in Akâsha, and manhood in men.

speaker: krishna
sa:
पुण्यो गन्धः पृथिव्यां च तेजश्चास्मि विभावसौ ।
जीवनं सर्वभूतेषु तपश्चास्मि तपस्विषु ॥
sa_padas: पुण्यो गन्धः पृथिव्यां च तेजश्चास्मि विभावसौ
iast_lib:
puṇyo gandhaḥ pṛthivyāṃ ca tejaścāsmi vibhāvasau |
jīvanaṃ sarvabhūteṣu tapaścāsmi tapasviṣu ||
en: The pure fragrance of earths and the bril liance in fire am I; the life in all beings am I, and the austerity in ascetics.
en_source: Besant 1922 (4th ed.) via en.wikisource [second-hand copy: Gita.AI]
en_swarupananda: I am the sweet fragrance in earth, and the brilliance in fire am I; the life in all beings, and the austerity am I in ascetics.

speaker: krishna
sa:
बीजं मां सर्वभूतानां विद्धि पार्थ सनातनम् ।
बुद्धिर्बुद्धिमतामस्मि तेजस्तेजस्विनामहम् ॥
sa_padas: बीजं मां सर्वभूतानां विद्धि पार्थ सनातनम्
iast_lib:
bījaṃ māṃ sarvabhūtānāṃ viddhi pārtha sanātanam |
buddhirbuddhimatāmasmi tejastejasvināmaham ||
en: Know Me, O Pârtha! as the eternal seed of all beings. I am the Reason of the Reason-endowed, the splendour of splendid things am I.
en_source: Besant 1922 (4th ed.) via en.wikisource [second-hand copy: Gita.AI]
en_swarupananda: Know Me, O son of Prithâ, as the eternal seed of all beings. I am the intellect of the intelligent, and the heroism of the heroic.

speaker: krishna
sa:
बलं बलवतां चाहं कामरागविवर्जितम् ।
धर्माविरुद्धो भूतेषु कामोऽस्मि भरतर्षभ ॥
iast_lib:
balaṃ balavatāṃ cāhaṃ kāmarāgavivarjitam |
dharmāviruddho bhūteṣu kāmo'smi bharatarṣabha ||
en: And I the strength of the strong, devoid of desire and passion. In beings I am desire not contrary to duty, O Lord of the Bharatas.
en_source: Besant 1922 (4th ed.) via en.wikisource [second-hand copy: Gita.AI]
en_swarupananda: Of the strong, I am the strength devoid of desire and attachment. I am, O bull among the Bhâratas, desire in beings, unopposed to Dharma.

speaker: krishna
sa:
ये चैव सात्त्विका भावा राजसास्तामसाश्च ये ।
मत्त एवेति तान्विद्धि नत्वहं तेषु ते मयि ॥
sa_padas: ये चैव सात्त्विका भावा राजसास्तामसाश्च ये
मत्त एवेति तान्विद्धि नत्वहं तेषु ते मयि
iast_lib:
ye caiva sāttvikā bhāvā rājasāstāmasāśca ye |
matta eveti tānviddhi natvahaṃ teṣu te mayi ||
en: The natures that are harmonious, active, slothful, these know as from Me; not I in them, but they in me.
en_source: Besant 1922 (4th ed.) via en.wikisource [second-hand copy: Gita.AI]
en_swarupananda: And whatever states pertaining to Sattva, and those pertaining to Rajas, and to Tamas, know them to proceed from Me alone; still I am not in them, but they are in Me.

speaker: krishna
sa:
त्रिभिर्गुणमयैर्भावैरेभिः सर्वमिदं जगत् ।
मोहितं नाभिजानाति मामेभ्यः परमव्ययम् ॥
iast_lib:
tribhirguṇamayairbhāvairebhiḥ sarvamidaṃ jagat |
mohitaṃ nābhijānāti māmebhyaḥ paramavyayam ||
en: All this world, deluded by these natures made by the three qualities, knoweth not Me, above these, imperishable.
en_source: Besant 1922 (4th ed.) via en.wikisource [second-hand copy: Gita.AI]
en_swarupananda: Deluded by these states, the modifications of the three Gunas (of Prakriti), all this world does not know Me, beyond them, and immutable.

speaker: krishna
sa:
दैवी ह्येषा गुणमयी मम माया दुरत्यया ।
मामेव ये प्रपद्यन्ते मायामेतां तरन्ति ते ॥
sa_padas: दैवी ह्येषा गुणमयी मम माया दुरत्यया
मामेव ये प्रपद्यन्ते मायामेतां तरन्ति ते
iast_lib:
daivī hyeṣā guṇamayī mama māyā duratyayā |
māmeva ye prapadyante māyāmetāṃ taranti te ||
en: This divine illusion of Mine, caused by the qualities, is hard to pierce; they who come to Me, they cross over this illusion.
en_source: Besant 1922 (4th ed.) via en.wikisource [second-hand copy: Gita.AI]
en_swarupananda: Verily, this divine illusion of Mine, constituted of the Gunas, is difficult to cross over; those who devote themselves to Me alone, cross over this illusion.

speaker: krishna
sa:
न मां दुष्कृतिनो मूढाः प्रपद्यन्ते नराधमाः ।
माययापहृतज्ञाना आसुरं भावमाश्रिताः ॥
sa_padas: न मां दुष्कृतिनो मूढाः प्रपद्यन्ते नराधमाः
iast_lib:
na māṃ duṣkṛtino mūḍhāḥ prapadyante narādhamāḥ |
māyayāpahṛtajñānā āsuraṃ bhāvamāśritāḥ ||
en: The evil-doing, the deluded, the vilest men, they come not to Me, they whose wisdom is destroyed by illusion, who have embraced the nature of demons.
en_source: Besant 1922 (4th ed.) via en.wikisource [second-hand copy: Gita.AI]
en_swarupananda: They do not devote themselves to Me,—the evil-doers, the deluded, the lowest of men, deprived of discrimination by Mâyâ, and following the way of the Asuras.

speaker: krishna
sa:
चतुर्विधा भजन्ते मां जनाः सुकृतिनोऽर्जुन ।
आर्तो जिज्ञासुरर्थार्थी ज्ञानी च भरतर्षभ ॥
iast_lib:
caturvidhā bhajante māṃ janāḥ sukṛtino'rjuna |
ārto jijñāsurarthārthī jñānī ca bharatarṣabha ||
en: Fourfold in division are the righteous ones who worship me, O Arjuna; the suffering, the seeker for knowledge, the self-interested and the wise, O Lord of the Bhâratas.
en_source: Besant 1922 (4th ed.) via en.wikisource [second-hand copy: Gita.AI]
en_swarupananda: Four kinds of virtuous men worship Me, O Arjuna,—the distressed, the seeker of knowledge, the seeker of enjoyment, and the wise, O bull among the Bhâratas.

speaker: krishna
sa:
तेषां ज्ञानी नित्ययुक्त एकभक्तिर्विशिष्यते ।
प्रियो हि ज्ञानिनोऽत्यर्थमहं स च मम प्रियः ॥
sa_padas: प्रियो हि ज्ञानिनोऽत्यर्थमहं स च मम प्रियः
iast_lib:
teṣāṃ jñānī nityayukta ekabhaktirviśiṣyate |
priyo hi jñānino'tyarthamahaṃ sa ca mama priyaḥ ||
en: Of these the wise, constantly harmonised, worshipping the One, is the best; I am supremely dear to the wise, and he is dear to Me.
en_source: Besant 1922 (4th ed.) via en.wikisource [second-hand copy: Gita.AI]
en_swarupananda: Of them, the wise man, ever-steadfast, (and fired) with devotion to the One, excels; for supremely dear am I to the wise, and he is dear to Me.

speaker: krishna
sa:
उदाराः सर्व एवैते ज्ञानी त्वात्मैव मे मतम् ।
आस्थितः स हि युक्तात्मा मामेवानुत्तमां गतिम् ॥
sa_padas: उदाराः सर्व एवैते ज्ञानी त्वात्मैव मे मतम्
आस्थितः स हि युक्तात्मा मामेवानुत्तमां गतिम्
iast_lib:
udārāḥ sarva evaite jñānī tvātmaiva me matam |
āsthitaḥ sa hi yuktātmā māmevānuttamāṃ gatim ||
en: Noble are all these, but I hold the wise as verily Myself; he, Self united, is fixed on Me, the highest Path.
en_source: Besant 1922 (4th ed.) via en.wikisource [second-hand copy: Gita.AI]
en_swarupananda: Noble indeed are they all, but the wise man I regard as My very Self; for with the mind steadfast, he is established in Me alone, as the supreme goal.

speaker: krishna
sa:
बहूनां जन्मनामन्ते ज्ञानवान्मां प्रपद्यते ।
वासुदेवः सर्वमिति स महात्मा सुदुर्लभः ॥
iast_lib:
bahūnāṃ janmanāmante jñānavānmāṃ prapadyate |
vāsudevaḥ sarvamiti sa mahātmā sudurlabhaḥ ||
en: At the close of many births the man full of wisdom cometh unto Me; "Vâsudeva is all." saith he, the Mahâtmâ, very difficult to find.
en_source: Besant 1922 (4th ed.) via en.wikisource [second-hand copy: Gita.AI]
en_swarupananda: At the end of many births, the man of wisdom takes refuge in Me, realising that all this is Vâsudeva (the innermost Self). Very rare is that great soul.

speaker: krishna
sa:
कामैस्तैस्तैर्हृतज्ञानाः प्रपद्यन्तेऽन्यदेवताः ।
तं तं नियममास्थाय प्रकृत्या नियताः स्वया ॥
sa_padas: तं तं नियममास्थाय प्रकृत्या नियताः स्वया
iast_lib:
kāmaistaistairhṛtajñānāḥ prapadyante'nyadevatāḥ |
taṃ taṃ niyamamāsthāya prakṛtyā niyatāḥ svayā ||
en: They whose wisdom hath been rent away by desires go forth to other Shining Ones, resorting to various external observances, according to their own natures.
en_source: Besant 1922 (4th ed.) via en.wikisource [second-hand copy: Gita.AI]
en_swarupananda: Others again, deprived of discrimination by this or that desire, following this or that rite, devote themselves to other gods, led by their own natures.

speaker: krishna
sa:
यो यो यां यां तनुं भक्तः श्रद्धयार्चितुमिच्छति ।
तस्य तस्याचलां श्रद्धां तामेव विदधाम्यहम् ॥
sa_padas: यो यो यां यां तनुं भक्तः श्रद्धयार्चितुमिच्छति
iast_lib:
yo yo yāṃ yāṃ tanuṃ bhaktaḥ śraddhayārcitumicchati |
tasya tasyācalāṃ śraddhāṃ tāmeva vidadhāmyaham ||
en: Any devotee who seeketh to worship with faith any such aspect, I verily bestow the unswerving faith of that man.
en_source: Besant 1922 (4th ed.) via en.wikisource [second-hand copy: Gita.AI]
en_swarupananda: Whatsoever form any devotee seeks to worship with Shraddhâ,—that Shraddhâ of his do I make unwavering.

speaker: krishna
sa:
स तया श्रद्धया युक्तस्तस्याराधनमीहते ।
लभते च ततः कामान्मयैव विहितान् हि तान् ॥
sa_padas: लभते च ततः कामान्मयैव विहितान् हि तान्
iast_lib:
sa tayā śraddhayā yuktastasyārādhanamīhate |
labhate ca tataḥ kāmānmayaiva vihitān hi tān ||
en: He endowed with that faith, seeketh the worship of such a one, and from him he obtaineth his desires, I verily decreeing the benefits;
en_source: Besant 1922 (4th ed.) via en.wikisource [second-hand copy: Gita.AI]
en_swarupananda: Endued with that Shraddhâ, he engages in the worship of that, and from it, gains his desires,—these being verily dispensed by Me alone.

speaker: krishna
sa:
अन्तवत्तु फलं तेषां तद्भवत्यल्पमेधसाम् ।
देवान्देवयजो यान्ति मद्भक्ता यान्ति मामपि ॥
iast_lib:
antavattu phalaṃ teṣāṃ tadbhavatyalpamedhasām |
devāndevayajo yānti madbhaktā yānti māmapi ||
en: Finite indeed the fruit that belongeth to those who are of small intelligence. To the Shining Ones go the worshippers of the Shining Ones, but my devotees come unto Me.
en_source: Besant 1922 (4th ed.) via en.wikisource [second-hand copy: Gita.AI]
en_swarupananda: But the fruit (accruing) to these men of little understanding is limited. The worshippers of the Devas go to the Devas; My devotees too come to me.

speaker: krishna
sa:
अव्यक्तं व्यक्तिमापन्नं मन्यन्ते मामबुद्धयः ।
परं भावमजानन्तो ममाव्ययमनुत्तमम् ॥
iast_lib:
avyaktaṃ vyaktimāpannaṃ manyante māmabuddhayaḥ |
paraṃ bhāvamajānanto mamāvyayamanuttamam ||
en: Those devoid of Reason think of Me, the unmanifest, as having manifestation, knowing not My supreme nature, imperishable, most excellent.
en_source: Besant 1922 (4th ed.) via en.wikisource [second-hand copy: Gita.AI]
en_swarupananda: The foolish regard Me, the un-manifested, as come into manifestation, not knowing My supreme state,—immutable and transcendental.

speaker: krishna
sa:
नाहं प्रकाशः सर्वस्य योगमायासमावृतः ।
मूढोऽयं नाभिजानाति लोको मामजमव्ययम् ॥
iast_lib:
nāhaṃ prakāśaḥ sarvasya yogamāyāsamāvṛtaḥ |
mūḍho'yaṃ nābhijānāti loko māmajamavyayam ||
en: Nor am I of all discovered, enveloped in My creation-illusion. This deluded world knoweth Me not, the unborn, the imperishable.
en_source: Besant 1922 (4th ed.) via en.wikisource [second-hand copy: Gita.AI]
en_swarupananda: Veiled by the illusion born of the congress of the Gunas, I am not manifest to all. This deluded world knows Me not, the Unborn, the Immutable.

speaker: krishna
sa:
वेदाहं समतीतानि वर्तमानानि चार्जुन ।
भविष्याणि च भूतानि मां तु वेद न कश्चन ॥
sa_padas: भविष्याणि च भूतानि मां तु वेद न कश्चन
iast_lib:
vedāhaṃ samatītāni vartamānāni cārjuna |
bhaviṣyāṇi ca bhūtāni māṃ tu veda na kaścana ||
en: I know the beings that are past, that are present, that are to come, O Arjuna, but no one knoweth Me.
en_source: Besant 1922 (4th ed.) via en.wikisource [second-hand copy: Gita.AI]
en_swarupananda: I know, O Arjuna, the beings of the whole past, and the present, and the future, but Me none knoweth.

speaker: krishna
sa:
इच्छाद्वेषसमुत्थेन द्वन्द्वमोहेन भारत ।
सर्वभूतानि संमोहं सर्गे यान्ति परन्तप ॥
iast_lib:
icchādveṣasamutthena dvandvamohena bhārata |
sarvabhūtāni saṃmohaṃ sarge yānti parantapa ||
en: By the delusion of the pairs of opposites, sprung from attraction and repulsion, O Bhârata, all beings walk this universe wholly deluded, O Parantapa.
en_source: Besant 1922 (4th ed.) via en.wikisource [second-hand copy: Gita.AI]
en_swarupananda: By the delusion of the pairs of opposites, arising from desire and aversion, O descendant of Bharata, all beings fall into delusion at birth, O scorcher of foes.

speaker: krishna
sa:
येषां त्वन्तगतं पापं जनानां पुण्यकर्मणाम् ।
ते द्वन्द्वमोहनिर्मुक्ता भजन्ते मां दृढव्रताः ॥
iast_lib:
yeṣāṃ tvantagataṃ pāpaṃ janānāṃ puṇyakarmaṇām |
te dvandvamohanirmuktā bhajante māṃ dṛḍhavratāḥ ||
en: But those men of pure deeds, in whom sin is come to an end, they, freed from the delusive pairs of opposites, worship Me, steadfast in vows.
en_source: Besant 1922 (4th ed.) via en.wikisource [second-hand copy: Gita.AI]
en_swarupananda: Those men of virtuous deeds, whose sin has come to an end,—they, freed from the delusion of the pairs of opposites, worship Me with firm resolve.

speaker: krishna
sa:
जरामरणमोक्षाय मामाश्रित्य यतन्ति ये ।
ते ब्रह्म तद्विदुः कृत्स्नमध्यात्मं कर्म चाखिलम् ॥
sa_padas: ते ब्रह्म तद्विदुः कृत्स्नमध्यात्मं कर्म चाखिलम्
iast_lib:
jarāmaraṇamokṣāya māmāśritya yatanti ye |
te brahma tadviduḥ kṛtsnamadhyātmaṃ karma cākhilam ||
en: They who, refuged in Me, strive for liberation from birth and death, they know the Eternal, the whole Self -knowledge, and all action.
en_source: Besant 1922 (4th ed.) via en.wikisource [second-hand copy: Gita.AI]
en_swarupananda: Those who strive for freedom from old age and death, taking refuge in Me, they know. Brahman, the whole of Adhyâtma, and Karma in its entirety.

speaker: krishna
sa:
साधिभूताधिदैवं मां साधियज्ञं च ये विदुः ।
प्रयाणकालेऽपि च मां ते विदुर्युक्तचेतसः ॥
sa_padas: साधिभूताधिदैवं मां साधियज्ञं च ये विदुः
iast_lib:
sādhibhūtādhidaivaṃ māṃ sādhiyajñaṃ ca ye viduḥ |
prayāṇakāle'pi ca māṃ te viduryuktacetasaḥ ||
en: They who know Me as the knowledge of the elements, as that of the Shining Ones, and as that of the Sacrifice, they harmonised in mind, know Me verily even in the time of forthgoing.
en_source: Besant 1922 (4th ed.) via en.wikisource [second-hand copy: Gita.AI]
en_swarupananda: Those who know Me with the Adhibhuta, the Adhidaiva, and the Adhiyajna, (continue to) know Me even at the time of death, steadfast in mind.

speaker: arjuna
sa:
किं तद्ब्रह्म किमध्यात्मं किं कर्म पुरुषोत्तम ।
अधिभूतं च किं प्रोक्तमधिदैवं किमुच्यते ॥
sa_padas: किं तद्ब्रह्म किमध्यात्मं किं कर्म पुरुषोत्तम
iast_lib:
kiṃ tadbrahma kimadhyātmaṃ kiṃ karma puruṣottama |
adhibhūtaṃ ca kiṃ proktamadhidaivaṃ kimucyate ||
en: Arjuna said: What is that Eternal, what Self -knowledge, what Action, O Purushottama? And what is declared to be the knowledge of the Elements, what is called the knowledge of the Shining Ones?
en_source: Besant 1922 (4th ed.) via en.wikisource [second-hand copy: Gita.AI]
en_swarupananda: What is that Brahman, what is Adhyâtma, what is Karma, O best of Purushas? What is called Adhibhuta, and what Adhidaiva?

speaker: arjuna
sa:
अधियज्ञः कथं कोऽत्र देहेऽस्मिन्मधुसूदन ।
प्रयाणकाले च कथं ज्ञेयोऽसि नियतात्मभिः ॥
iast_lib:
adhiyajñaḥ kathaṃ ko'tra dehe'sminmadhusūdana |
prayāṇakāle ca kathaṃ jñeyo'si niyatātmabhiḥ ||
en: What is the knowledge of Sacrifice in this body, and how, O, Madhusûdana? And how, at the time of forthgoing art Thou known by the Self -controlled?
en_source: Besant 1922 (4th ed.) via en.wikisource [second-hand copy: Gita.AI]
en_swarupananda: Who, and in what way, is Adhiyajna here in this body, O destroyer of Madhu? And how art Thou known at the time of death, by the self-controlled?

speaker: krishna
sa:
अक्षरं ब्रह्म परमं स्वभावोऽध्यात्ममुच्यते ।
भूतभावोद्भवकरो विसर्गः कर्मसंज्ञितः ॥
iast_lib:
akṣaraṃ brahma paramaṃ svabhāvo'dhyātmamucyate |
bhūtabhāvodbhavakaro visargaḥ karmasaṃjñitaḥ ||
en: The Blessed Lord said: The indestructible, the supreme is the Eternal; His essential nature is called Self -knowledge; the emanation that causes the birth of beings is named Action;
en_source: Besant 1922 (4th ed.) via en.wikisource [second-hand copy: Gita.AI]
en_swarupananda: The Imperishable is the Supreme Brahman. Its dwelling in each individual body is called Adhyâtma; the offering in sacrifice which causes the genesis and support of beings, is called Karma.

speaker: krishna
sa:
अधिभूतं क्षरो भावः पुरुषश्चाधिदैवतम् ।
अधियज्ञोऽहमेवात्र देहे देहभृतां वर ॥
iast_lib:
adhibhūtaṃ kṣaro bhāvaḥ puruṣaścādhidaivatam |
adhiyajño'hamevātra dehe dehabhṛtāṃ vara ||
en: Knowledge of the Elements concerns My perishable nature, and knowledge of the Shining Ones concerns the life-giving energy; the knowledge of Sacrifice tells of Me, as wearing the body, O best of living beings.
en_source: Besant 1922 (4th ed.) via en.wikisource [second-hand copy: Gita.AI]
en_swarupananda: The perishable adjunct is the Adhibhuta, and the Indweller is the Adhidaivata; I alone am the Adhiyajna here in this body, O best of the embodied.

speaker: krishna
sa:
अन्तकाले च मामेव स्मरन्मुक्त्वा कलेवरम् ।
यः प्रयाति स मद्भावं याति नास्त्यत्र संशयः ॥
sa_padas: यः प्रयाति स मद्भावं याति नास्त्यत्र संशयः
iast_lib:
antakāle ca māmeva smaranmuktvā kalevaram |
yaḥ prayāti sa madbhāvaṃ yāti nāstyatra saṃśayaḥ ||
en: And he who, casting off the body, goeth forth thinking upon Me only at the time of the end, he entereth into My being: there is no doubt of that.
en_source: Besant 1922 (4th ed.) via en.wikisource [second-hand copy: Gita.AI]
en_swarupananda: And he, who at the time of death, meditating on Me alone, goes forth, leaving the body, attains My Being: there is no doubt about this.

speaker: krishna
sa:
यं यं वापि स्मरन्भावं त्यजत्यन्ते कलेवरम् ।
तं तमेवैति कौन्तेय सदा तद्भावभावितः ॥
sa_padas: यं यं वापि स्मरन्भावं त्यजत्यन्ते कलेवरम्
iast_lib:
yaṃ yaṃ vāpi smaranbhāvaṃ tyajatyante kalevaram |
taṃ tamevaiti kaunteya sadā tadbhāvabhāvitaḥ ||
en: Whosoever at the end abandoneth the body, thinking upon any being, to that being only he goeth, O Kaunteya, ever to that conformed in nature.
en_source: Besant 1922 (4th ed.) via en.wikisource [second-hand copy: Gita.AI]
en_swarupananda: Remembering whatever object, at the end, he leaves the body, that alone is reached by him, O son of Kunti, (because) of his constant thought of that object.

speaker: krishna
sa:
तस्मात्सर्वेषु कालेषु मामनुस्मर युध्य च ।
मय्यर्पितमनोबुद्धिर्मामेवैष्यस्यसंशयम् ॥
iast_lib:
tasmātsarveṣu kāleṣu māmanusmara yudhya ca |
mayyarpitamanobuddhirmāmevaiṣyasyasaṃśayam ||
en: Therefore at all times think upon Me only and fight. With mind and Reason set on Me, without doubt thou shalt come to Me.
en_source: Besant 1922 (4th ed.) via en.wikisource [second-hand copy: Gita.AI]
en_swarupananda: Therefore, at all times, constantly remember Me, and fight. With mind and intellect absorbed, in Me, thou shalt doubtless come to Me.

sa_review.why: A (base) is outvoted by agreeing independent witnesses

readings.A: तस्मात्सर्वेषु कालेषु मामनुस्मर युध्य च मय्यर्पितमनोबुद्धिर्मामेवैष्यस्यसंशयम्
readings.C: tasmāt sarveṣu kāleṣu mām anusmara yudhya ca mayy arpitamanobuddhir mām evaiṣyasy asaṃśayaḥ
readings.D: tasmātsarveṣu kāleṣu māmanusmara yudhya ca mayyarpitamanobuddhirmāmevaiṣyasyasaṃśayaḥ
readings.V: तस्मात्सर्वेषु कालेषु मामनुस्मर युध्य च मय्यर्पितमनोबुद्धिर्मामेवैष्यस्यसंशयः (orसंशयम्)

speaker: krishna
sa:
अभ्यासयोगयुक्तेन चेतसा नान्यगामिना ।
परमं पुरुषं दिव्यं याति पार्थानुचिन्तयन् ॥
iast_lib:
abhyāsayogayuktena cetasā nānyagāminā |
paramaṃ puruṣaṃ divyaṃ yāti pārthānucintayan ||
en: With the mind not wandering after aught else, harmonised by continual practice, constantly meditating, O Pârtha, one goeth to the Spirit supreme, divine.
en_source: Besant 1922 (4th ed.) via en.wikisource [second-hand copy: Gita.AI]
en_swarupananda: With the mind not moving towards anything else, made steadfast by the method of habitual meditation, and dwelling on the Supreme, Resplendent Purusha, O son of Prithâ, one goes to Him.

speaker: krishna
sa:
कविं पुराणमनुशासितार
मणोरणीयांसमनुस्मरेद्यः ।
सर्वस्य धातारमचिन्त्यरूप
मादित्यवर्णं तमसः परस्तात् ॥
iast_lib:
kaviṃ purāṇamanuśāsitāra
maṇoraṇīyāṃsamanusmaredyaḥ |
sarvasya dhātāramacintyarūpa
mādityavarṇaṃ tamasaḥ parastāt ||
en: He who thinketh upon the Ancient, the Omniscient, the All-Ruler, minuter than the minute, the supporter of all, of form unimaginable, refulgent as the sun beyond the darkness,
en_source: Besant 1922 (4th ed.) via en.wikisource [second-hand copy: Gita.AI]
en_swarupananda: The Omniscient, the Ancient, the Overruler, minuter than an atom, the Sustainer of all, of form inconceivable, self-luminous like the sun, and beyond the darkness of Mâyâ—he who meditates on Him thus, at the time of death, full of devotion, with the mind unmoving, and also by the power of Yoga, fixing the whole Prâna betwixt the eye-brows, he goes to that Supreme, Resplendent Purusha.

speaker: krishna
sa:
प्रयाणकाले मनसाऽचलेन
भक्त्या युक्तो योगबलेन चैव ।
भ्रुवोर्मध्ये प्राणमावेश्य सम्यक्
स तं परं पुरुषमुपैति दिव्यम् ॥
iast_lib:
prayāṇakāle manasā'calena
bhaktyā yukto yogabalena caiva |
bhruvormadhye prāṇamāveśya samyak
sa taṃ paraṃ puruṣamupaiti divyam ||
en: In the time of forthgoing, with unshaken mind, fixed in devotion, by the power of yoga drawing together his life-breath in the centre of the two eyebrows, he goeth to this Spirit, supreme, divine.
en_source: Besant 1922 (4th ed.) via en.wikisource [second-hand copy: Gita.AI]
en_swarupananda: The Omniscient, the Ancient, the Overruler, minuter than an atom, the Sustainer of all, of form inconceivable, self-luminous like the sun, and beyond the darkness of Mâyâ—he who meditates on Him thus, at the time of death, full of devotion, with the mind unmoving, and also by the power of Yoga, fixing the whole Prâna betwixt the eye-brows, he goes to that Supreme, Resplendent Purusha.

speaker: krishna
sa:
यदक्षरं वेदविदो वदन्ति
विशन्ति यद्यतयो वीतरागाः ।
यदिच्छन्तो ब्रह्मचर्यं चरन्ति
तत्ते पदं संग्रहेण प्रवक्ष्ये ॥
iast_lib:
yadakṣaraṃ vedavido vadanti
viśanti yadyatayo vītarāgāḥ |
yadicchanto brahmacaryaṃ caranti
tatte padaṃ saṃgraheṇa pravakṣye ||
en: That which is declared indestructible by the Veda-knowers, that which the controlled and passion-free enter, that desiring which Brahmacharya is performed, that path I will declare to thee with brevity.
en_source: Besant 1922 (4th ed.) via en.wikisource [second-hand copy: Gita.AI]
en_swarupananda: What the knowers of the Veda speak of as Imperishable, what the self-controlled (Sannyâsins), freed from attachment enter, and to gain which goal they live the life of a Brahmachârin, that I shall declare unto thee in brief.

speaker: krishna
sa:
सर्वद्वाराणि संयम्य मनो हृदि निरुध्य च ।
मूर्ध्न्याधायात्मनः प्राणमास्थितो योगधारणाम् ॥
sa_padas: सर्वद्वाराणि संयम्य मनो हृदि निरुध्य च
iast_lib:
sarvadvārāṇi saṃyamya mano hṛdi nirudhya ca |
mūrdhnyādhāyātmanaḥ prāṇamāsthito yogadhāraṇām ||
en: All the gates closed, the mind confined in the heart, the life-breath fixed in his own head, concentrated by yoga,
en_source: Besant 1922 (4th ed.) via en.wikisource [second-hand copy: Gita.AI]
en_swarupananda: Controlling all the senses, confining the mind in the heart, drawing the Prâna into the head, occupied in the practice of concentration, uttering the one-syllabled "Om"—the Brahman, and meditating on Me;—he who so departs, leaving the body, attains the Supreme Goal.

speaker: krishna
sa:
ओमित्येकाक्षरं ब्रह्म व्याहरन्मामनुस्मरन् ।
यः प्रयाति त्यजन्देहं स याति परमां गतिम् ॥
sa_padas: यः प्रयाति त्यजन्देहं स याति परमां गतिम्
iast_lib:
omityekākṣaraṃ brahma vyāharanmāmanusmaran |
yaḥ prayāti tyajandehaṃ sa yāti paramāṃ gatim ||
en: "Aum!" the one syllabled Eternal, reciting, thinking upon Me, he who goeth forth, abandoning the body, he goeth on the highest path.
en_source: Besant 1922 (4th ed.) via en.wikisource [second-hand copy: Gita.AI]
en_swarupananda: Controlling all the senses, confining the mind in the heart, drawing the Prâna into the head, occupied in the practice of concentration, uttering the one-syllabled "Om"—the Brahman, and meditating on Me;—he who so departs, leaving the body, attains the Supreme Goal.

speaker: krishna
sa:
अनन्यचेताः सततं यो मां स्मरति नित्यशः ।
तस्याहं सुलभः पार्थ नित्ययुक्तस्य योगिनः ॥
sa_padas: अनन्यचेताः सततं यो मां स्मरति नित्यशः
iast_lib:
ananyacetāḥ satataṃ yo māṃ smarati nityaśaḥ |
tasyāhaṃ sulabhaḥ pārtha nityayuktasya yoginaḥ ||
en: He who constantly thinketh upon Me, not thinking ever of another, of him I am easily reached, O Pârtha, of this ever-harmonised Yogî.
en_source: Besant 1922 (4th ed.) via en.wikisource [second-hand copy: Gita.AI]
en_swarupananda: I am easily attainable by that ever-steadfast Yogin who remembers Me constantly and daily, with a single mind, O son of Prithâ.

speaker: krishna
sa:
मामुपेत्य पुनर्जन्म दुःखालयमशाश्वतम् ।
नाप्नुवन्ति महात्मानः संसिद्धिं परमां गताः ॥
iast_lib:
māmupetya punarjanma duḥkhālayamaśāśvatam |
nāpnuvanti mahātmānaḥ saṃsiddhiṃ paramāṃ gatāḥ ||
en: Having come to Me, these Mahâtmâs come not again to birth, the place of pain, non-eternal; they have gone to the highest bliss.
en_source: Besant 1922 (4th ed.) via en.wikisource [second-hand copy: Gita.AI]
en_swarupananda: Reaching the highest perfection, and having attained Me, the great-souled ones are no more subject to re-birth—which is the home of pain, and ephemeral.

speaker: krishna
sa:
आब्रह्मभुवनाल्लोकाः पुनरावर्तिनोऽर्जुन ।
मामुपेत्य तु कौन्तेय पुनर्जन्म न विद्यते ॥
sa_padas: मामुपेत्य तु कौन्तेय पुनर्जन्म न विद्यते
iast_lib:
ābrahmabhuvanāllokāḥ punarāvartino'rjuna |
māmupetya tu kaunteya punarjanma na vidyate ||
en: The worlds, beginning with the world of Brahmâ, they come and go, O Arjuna; but he who cometh unto Me, O Kaunteya, he knoweth birth no more.
en_source: Besant 1922 (4th ed.) via en.wikisource [second-hand copy: Gita.AI]
en_swarupananda: All the worlds, O Arjuna, including the realm of Brahmâ, are subject to return, but after attaining Me, O son of Kunti, there is no re-birth.

speaker: krishna
sa:
सहस्रयुगपर्यन्तमहर्यद्ब्रह्मणो विदुः ।
रात्रिं युगसहस्रान्तां तेऽहोरात्रविदो जनाः ॥
iast_lib:
sahasrayugaparyantamaharyadbrahmaṇo viduḥ |
rātriṃ yugasahasrāntāṃ te'horātravido janāḥ ||
en: The people who know the day of Brahmâ, a thousand ages in duration, and the night a thousand ages in ending, they know day and night.
en_source: Besant 1922 (4th ed.) via en.wikisource [second-hand copy: Gita.AI]
en_swarupananda: They who know (the true measure of) day and night, know the day of Brahmâ, which ends in a thousand Yugas, and the night which (also) ends in a thousand Yugas.

speaker: krishna
sa:
अव्यक्ताद्व्यक्तयः सर्वाः प्रभवन्त्यहरागमे ।
रात्र्यागमे प्रलीयन्ते तत्रैवाव्यक्तसंज्ञके ॥
iast_lib:
avyaktādvyaktayaḥ sarvāḥ prabhavantyaharāgame |
rātryāgame pralīyante tatraivāvyaktasaṃjñake ||
en: From the unmanifested all the manifested stream forth at the coming of day; at the coming of night they dissolve, even in That called the unmanifested.
en_source: Besant 1922 (4th ed.) via en.wikisource [second-hand copy: Gita.AI]
en_swarupananda: At the approach of (Brahmâ's) day, all manifestations proceed from the unmanifested state; at the approach of night, they merge verily into that alone, which is called the unmanifested.

speaker: krishna
sa:
भूतग्रामः स एवायं भूत्वा भूत्वा प्रलीयते ।
रात्र्यागमेऽवशः पार्थ प्रभवत्यहरागमे ॥
sa_padas: भूतग्रामः स एवायं भूत्वा भूत्वा प्रलीयते
iast_lib:
bhūtagrāmaḥ sa evāyaṃ bhūtvā bhūtvā pralīyate |
rātryāgame'vaśaḥ pārtha prabhavatyaharāgame ||
en: This multitude of beings, going forth repeatedly, is dissolved at the coming of night: by ordination, O Pârtha, it streams forth at the coming of day.
en_source: Besant 1922 (4th ed.) via en.wikisource [second-hand copy: Gita.AI]
en_swarupananda: The very same multitude of beings (that existed in the preceding day of Brahmâ), being born again and again, merge, in spite of themselves, O son of Prithâ, (into the unmanifested), at the approach of night, and re-manifest at the approach of day.

speaker: krishna
sa:
परस्तस्मात्तु भावोऽन्योऽव्यक्तोऽव्यक्तात्सनातनः ।
यः स सर्वेषु भूतेषु नश्यत्सु न विनश्यति ॥
sa_padas: यः स सर्वेषु भूतेषु नश्यत्सु न विनश्यति
iast_lib:
parastasmāttu bhāvo'nyo'vyakto'vyaktātsanātanaḥ |
yaḥ sa sarveṣu bhūteṣu naśyatsu na vinaśyati ||
en: Therefore verily there existeth, higher than that unmanifested, another unmanifested, eternal, which in the destroying of all beings, is not destroyed.
en_source: Besant 1922 (4th ed.) via en.wikisource [second-hand copy: Gita.AI]
en_swarupananda: But beyond this unmanifested, there is that other Unmanifested, Eternal Existence—That which is not destroyed at the destruction of all beings.

speaker: krishna
sa:
अव्यक्तोऽक्षर इत्युक्तस्तमाहुः परमां गतिम् ।
यं प्राप्य न निवर्तन्ते तद्धाम परमं मम ॥
sa_padas: यं प्राप्य न निवर्तन्ते तद्धाम परमं मम
iast_lib:
avyakto'kṣara ityuktastamāhuḥ paramāṃ gatim |
yaṃ prāpya na nivartante taddhāma paramaṃ mama ||
en: That unmanifested, "the Indestructible," It is called; It is named the highest Path. They who reach It return not. That is My supreme abode.
en_source: Besant 1922 (4th ed.) via en.wikisource [second-hand copy: Gita.AI]
en_swarupananda: What has been called Unmanifested and Imperishable, has been described as the Goal Supreme. That is My highest state, having attained which, there is no return.

speaker: krishna
sa:
पुरुषः स परः पार्थ भक्त्या लभ्यस्त्वनन्यया ।
यस्यान्तःस्थानि भूतानि येन सर्वमिदं ततम् ॥
sa_padas: पुरुषः स परः पार्थ भक्त्या लभ्यस्त्वनन्यया
iast_lib:
puruṣaḥ sa paraḥ pārtha bhaktyā labhyastvananyayā |
yasyāntaḥsthāni bhūtāni yena sarvamidaṃ tatam ||
en: He, the highest Spirit, O Pârtha, may be reached by unswerving devotion to Him alone, in whom all beings abide, by whom all This is pervaded.
en_source: Besant 1922 (4th ed.) via en.wikisource [second-hand copy: Gita.AI]
en_swarupananda: And that Supreme Purusha is attainable, O son of Prithâ, by whole-souled devotion to Him alone, in Whom all beings dwell, and by Whom all this is pervaded.

speaker: krishna
sa:
यत्र काले त्वनावृत्तिमावृत्तिं चैव योगिनः ।
प्रयाता यान्ति तं कालं वक्ष्यामि भरतर्षभ ॥
sa_padas: प्रयाता यान्ति तं कालं वक्ष्यामि भरतर्षभ
iast_lib:
yatra kāle tvanāvṛttimāvṛttiṃ caiva yoginaḥ |
prayātā yānti taṃ kālaṃ vakṣyāmi bharatarṣabha ||
en: That time wherein going forth Yogîs return not, and also that wherein going forth they return, that time shall I declare to thee, O prince of the Bhâratas.
en_source: Besant 1922 (4th ed.) via en.wikisource [second-hand copy: Gita.AI]
en_swarupananda: Now I shall tell thee, O bull of the Bhâratas, of the time (path) travelling in which, the Yogis return, (and again of that, taking which) they do not return.

speaker: krishna
sa:
अग्निर्ज्योतिरहः शुक्लः षण्मासा उत्तरायणम् ।
तत्र प्रयाता गच्छन्ति ब्रह्म ब्रह्मविदो जनाः ॥
sa_padas: तत्र प्रयाता गच्छन्ति ब्रह्म ब्रह्मविदो जनाः
iast_lib:
agnirjyotirahaḥ śuklaḥ ṣaṇmāsā uttarāyaṇam |
tatra prayātā gacchanti brahma brahmavido janāḥ ||
en: Fire, light, day-time, the bright fortnight, the six months of the northern path—then, going forth, the men who know the Eternal go to the Eternal.
en_source: Besant 1922 (4th ed.) via en.wikisource [second-hand copy: Gita.AI]
en_swarupananda: Fire, flame, day-time, the bright fortnight, the six months of the Northern passage of the sun, taking this path, the knowers of Brahman go to Brahman.

speaker: krishna
sa:
धूमो रात्रिस्तथा कृष्णः षण्मासा दक्षिणायनम् ।
तत्र चान्द्रमसं ज्योतिर्योगी प्राप्य निवर्तते ॥
iast_lib:
dhūmo rātristathā kṛṣṇaḥ ṣaṇmāsā dakṣiṇāyanam |
tatra cāndramasaṃ jyotiryogī prāpya nivartate ||
en: Smoke, night-time, the dark fortnight also, the six months of the southern path—then the Yogî, obtaining the moonlight, returneth.
en_source: Besant 1922 (4th ed.) via en.wikisource [second-hand copy: Gita.AI]
en_swarupananda: Smoke, night-time, the dark fortnight, the six months of the Southern passage of the sun—taking this path the Yogi, attaining the lunar light, returns.

speaker: krishna
sa:
शुक्लकृष्णे गती ह्येते जगतः शाश्वते मते ।
एकया यात्यनावृत्तिमन्ययाऽऽवर्तते पुनः ॥
sa_padas: शुक्लकृष्णे गती ह्येते जगतः शाश्वते मते
iast_lib:
śuklakṛṣṇe gatī hyete jagataḥ śāśvate mate |
ekayā yātyanāvṛttimanyayā''vartate punaḥ ||
en: Light and darkness, these are thought to be the world's everlasting paths; by the one he goeth who returneth not, by the other he who returneth again.
en_source: Besant 1922 (4th ed.) via en.wikisource [second-hand copy: Gita.AI]
en_swarupananda: Truly are these bright and dark paths of the world considered eternal: one leads to non-return; by the other, one returns.

speaker: krishna
sa:
नैते सृती पार्थ जानन्योगी मुह्यति कश्चन ।
तस्मात्सर्वेषु कालेषु योगयुक्तो भवार्जुन ॥
sa_padas: नैते सृती पार्थ जानन्योगी मुह्यति कश्चन
iast_lib:
naite sṛtī pārtha jānanyogī muhyati kaścana |
tasmātsarveṣu kāleṣu yogayukto bhavārjuna ||
en: Knowing these paths, O Pârtha, the Yogi is nowise perplexed. Therefore in all times be firm in yoga, O Arjuna.
en_source: Besant 1922 (4th ed.) via en.wikisource [second-hand copy: Gita.AI]
en_swarupananda: No Yogi, O son of Prithâ, is deluded after knowing these paths. Therefore, O Arjuna, be thou steadfast in Yoga, at all times.

speaker: krishna
sa:
वेदेषु यज्ञेषु तपःसु चैव
दानेषु यत्पुण्यफलं प्रदिष्टम् ।
अत्येति तत्सर्वमिदं विदित्वा
योगी परं स्थानमुपैति चाद्यम् ॥
iast_lib:
vedeṣu yajñeṣu tapaḥsu caiva
dāneṣu yatpuṇyaphalaṃ pradiṣṭam |
atyeti tatsarvamidaṃ viditvā
yogī paraṃ sthānamupaiti cādyam ||
en: The fruit of meritorious deeds, attached in the Vedas to sacrifices, to austerities, and also to almsgiving, the Yogî passeth all these by having known this, and goeth to the supreme and ancient Seat.
en_source: Besant 1922 (4th ed.) via en.wikisource [second-hand copy: Gita.AI]
en_swarupananda: Whatever meritorious effect is declared (in the Scriptures) to accrue from (the study of) the Vedas, (the performance of) Yajnas, (the practice of) austerities and gifts,—above all this rises the Yogi, having known this, and attains to the primeval, supreme Abode.

speaker: krishna
sa:
इदं तु ते गुह्यतमं प्रवक्ष्याम्यनसूयवे ।
ज्ञानं विज्ञानसहितं यज्ज्ञात्वा मोक्ष्यसेऽशुभात् ॥
iast_lib:
idaṃ tu te guhyatamaṃ pravakṣyāmyanasūyave |
jñānaṃ vijñānasahitaṃ yajjñātvā mokṣyase'śubhāt ||
en: The Blessed Lord said: To thee, the uncarping, verily shall I declare this profoundest Secret, wisdom with knowledge combined, which, having known, thou shalt be freed from evil.
en_source: Besant 1922 (4th ed.) via en.wikisource [second-hand copy: Gita.AI]
en_swarupananda: To thee, who dost not carp, verily shall I now declare this, the most profound knowledge, united with realisation, having known which, thou shalt be free from evil (Samsâra).

speaker: krishna
sa:
राजविद्या राजगुह्यं पवित्रमिदमुत्तमम् ।
प्रत्यक्षावगमं धर्म्यं सुसुखं कर्तुमव्ययम् ॥
iast_lib:
rājavidyā rājaguhyaṃ pavitramidamuttamam |
pratyakṣāvagamaṃ dharmyaṃ susukhaṃ kartumavyayam ||
en: Kingly Science, kingly Secret, supreme Purifier, this; intuitional, according to righteousness, very easy to perform, imperishable.
en_source: Besant 1922 (4th ed.) via en.wikisource [second-hand copy: Gita.AI]
en_swarupananda: Of sciences, the highest; of profundities, the deepest; of purifiers, the supreme, is this; realisable by direct perception, endowed with (immense) merit, very easy to perform, and of an imperishable nature.

speaker: krishna
sa:
अश्रद्दधानाः पुरुषा धर्मस्यास्य परन्तप ।
अप्राप्य मां निवर्तन्ते मृत्युसंसारवर्त्मनि ॥
iast_lib:
aśraddadhānāḥ puruṣā dharmasyāsya parantapa |
aprāpya māṃ nivartante mṛtyusaṃsāravartmani ||
en: Men without faith in this knowledge, O Parantapa, not reaching Me, return to the paths of this world of death.
en_source: Besant 1922 (4th ed.) via en.wikisource [second-hand copy: Gita.AI]
en_swarupananda: Persons without Shraddhâ for this Dharma, return, O scorcher of foes, without attaining Me, to the path of re-birth fraught with death.

speaker: krishna
sa:
मया ततमिदं सर्वं जगदव्यक्तमूर्तिना ।
मत्स्थानि सर्वभूतानि न चाहं तेष्ववस्थितः ॥
iast_lib:
mayā tatamidaṃ sarvaṃ jagadavyaktamūrtinā |
matsthāni sarvabhūtāni na cāhaṃ teṣvavasthitaḥ ||
en: By Me all this world is pervaded in My unmanifested aspect; all beings have root in Me, I am not rooted in them.
en_source: Besant 1922 (4th ed.) via en.wikisource [second-hand copy: Gita.AI]
en_swarupananda: All this world is pervaded by me in My unmanifested form: all beings exist in Me, but I do not dwell in them.

speaker: krishna
sa:
न च मत्स्थानि भूतानि पश्य मे योगमैश्वरम् ।
भूतभृन्न च भूतस्थो ममात्मा भूतभावनः ॥
sa_padas: न च मत्स्थानि भूतानि पश्य मे योगमैश्वरम्
iast_lib:
na ca matsthāni bhūtāni paśya me yogamaiśvaram |
bhūtabhṛnna ca bhūtastho mamātmā bhūtabhāvanaḥ ||
en: Nor have beings root in Me; behold My sovereign Yoga! The support of beings, yet not rooted in beings, My Self their efficient cause.
en_source: Besant 1922 (4th ed.) via en.wikisource [second-hand copy: Gita.AI]
en_swarupananda: Nor do beings exist in Me (in reality), behold My Divine Yoga! Bringing forth and supporting the beings, My Self does not dwell in them.

speaker: krishna
sa:
यथाऽऽकाशस्थितो नित्यं वायुः सर्वत्रगो महान् ।
तथा सर्वाणि भूतानि मत्स्थानीत्युपधारय ॥
iast_lib:
yathā''kāśasthito nityaṃ vāyuḥ sarvatrago mahān |
tathā sarvāṇi bhūtāni matsthānītyupadhāraya ||
en: As the mighty air everywhere moving is rooted in the Ether, so all beings rest rooted in Me—thus know thou.
en_source: Besant 1922 (4th ed.) via en.wikisource [second-hand copy: Gita.AI]
en_swarupananda: As the mighty wind, moving always everywhere, rests ever in the Akâsha, know thou, that even so do all beings rest in Me.

speaker: krishna
sa:
सर्वभूतानि कौन्तेय प्रकृतिं यान्ति मामिकाम् ।
कल्पक्षये पुनस्तानि कल्पादौ विसृजाम्यहम् ॥
iast_lib:
sarvabhūtāni kaunteya prakṛtiṃ yānti māmikām |
kalpakṣaye punastāni kalpādau visṛjāmyaham ||
en: All beings, O Kaunteya, enter my lower nature at the end of a world-age; at the beginning of a world-age again I emanate them.
en_source: Besant 1922 (4th ed.) via en.wikisource [second-hand copy: Gita.AI]
en_swarupananda: At the end of a Kalpa, O son of Kunti, all beings go back to My Prakriti: at the beginning of (another) Kalpa, I send them forth again.

speaker: krishna
sa:
प्रकृतिं स्वामवष्टभ्य विसृजामि पुनः पुनः ।
भूतग्राममिमं कृत्स्नमवशं प्रकृतेर्वशात् ॥
iast_lib:
prakṛtiṃ svāmavaṣṭabhya visṛjāmi punaḥ punaḥ |
bhūtagrāmamimaṃ kṛtsnamavaśaṃ prakṛtervaśāt ||
en: Hidden in Nature, which is mine own, I emanate again and again all this multitude of beings, helpless, by the force of Nature.
en_source: Besant 1922 (4th ed.) via en.wikisource [second-hand copy: Gita.AI]
en_swarupananda: Animating My Prakriti, I project again and again this whole multitude of beings, helpless under the sway of Prakriti.

speaker: krishna
sa:
न च मां तानि कर्माणि निबध्नन्ति धनञ्जय ।
उदासीनवदासीनमसक्तं तेषु कर्मसु ॥
sa_padas: न च मां तानि कर्माणि निबध्नन्ति धनञ्जय
iast_lib:
na ca māṃ tāni karmāṇi nibadhnanti dhanañjaya |
udāsīnavadāsīnamasaktaṃ teṣu karmasu ||
en: Nor do these works bind me, O Dhananjaya, enthroned on high unattached to actions.
en_source: Besant 1922 (4th ed.) via en.wikisource [second-hand copy: Gita.AI]
en_swarupananda: These acts do not bind Me, sitting as one neutral, unattached to them, O Dhananjaya.

speaker: krishna
sa:
मयाऽध्यक्षेण प्रकृतिः सूयते सचराचरम् ।
हेतुनाऽनेन कौन्तेय जगद्विपरिवर्तते ॥
iast_lib:
mayā'dhyakṣeṇa prakṛtiḥ sūyate sacarācaram |
hetunā'nena kaunteya jagadviparivartate ||
en: Under Me as supervisor, Nature sends forth the moving and unmoving: because of this, O Kaunteya, the universe revolves.
en_source: Besant 1922 (4th ed.) via en.wikisource [second-hand copy: Gita.AI]
en_swarupananda: By reason of My proximity, Prakriti produces all this, the moving and the unmoving; the world wheels round and round, O son of Kunti, because of this.

speaker: krishna
sa:
अवजानन्ति मां मूढा मानुषीं तनुमाश्रितम् ।
परं भावमजानन्तो मम भूतमहेश्वरम् ॥
iast_lib:
avajānanti māṃ mūḍhā mānuṣīṃ tanumāśritam |
paraṃ bhāvamajānanto mama bhūtamaheśvaram ||
en: The foolish disregard Me, when clad in human semblance, ignorant of My supreme nature, the great Lord of beings;
en_source: Besant 1922 (4th ed.) via en.wikisource [second-hand copy: Gita.AI]
en_swarupananda: Unaware of My higher state, as the great Lord of beings, fools disregard Me, dwelling in the human form.

speaker: krishna
sa:
मोघाशा मोघकर्माणो मोघज्ञाना विचेतसः ।
राक्षसीमासुरीं चैव प्रकृतिं मोहिनीं श्रिताः ॥
iast_lib:
moghāśā moghakarmāṇo moghajñānā vicetasaḥ |
rākṣasīmāsurīṃ caiva prakṛtiṃ mohinīṃ śritāḥ ||
en: Empty of hope, empty of deeds, empty of wisdom, senseless, partaking of the deceitful, brutal and demoniacal nature.
en_source: Besant 1922 (4th ed.) via en.wikisource [second-hand copy: Gita.AI]
en_swarupananda: Of vain hopes, of vain works, of vain knowledge, and senseless, they verily are possessed of the delusive nature of Râkshasas and Asuras.

speaker: krishna
sa:
महात्मानस्तु मां पार्थ दैवीं प्रकृतिमाश्रिताः ।
भजन्त्यनन्यमनसो ज्ञात्वा भूतादिमव्ययम् ॥
iast_lib:
mahātmānastu māṃ pārtha daivīṃ prakṛtimāśritāḥ |
bhajantyananyamanaso jñātvā bhūtādimavyayam ||
en: Verily the Mahâtmâs, O Partha, partaking of My divine nature, worship with unwavering mind, having known Me, the imperishable source of beings.
en_source: Besant 1922 (4th ed.) via en.wikisource [second-hand copy: Gita.AI]
en_swarupananda: But the great-souled ones, O son of Prithâ, possessed of the Divine Prakriti, knowing Me to be the origin of beings, and immutable, worship Me with a single mind.

speaker: krishna
sa:
सततं कीर्तयन्तो मां यतन्तश्च दृढव्रताः ।
नमस्यन्तश्च मां भक्त्या नित्ययुक्ता उपासते ॥
iast_lib:
satataṃ kīrtayanto māṃ yatantaśca dṛḍhavratāḥ |
namasyantaśca māṃ bhaktyā nityayuktā upāsate ||
en: Always magnifying Me, strenuous, firm in vows, prostrating themselves before Me, they worship Me with devotion ever harmonised.
en_source: Besant 1922 (4th ed.) via en.wikisource [second-hand copy: Gita.AI]
en_swarupananda: Glorifying Me always and striving with firm resolve, bowing down to Me in devotion, always steadfast, they worship Me.

speaker: krishna
sa:
ज्ञानयज्ञेन चाप्यन्ये यजन्तो मामुपासते ।
एकत्वेन पृथक्त्वेन बहुधा विश्वतोमुखम् ॥
iast_lib:
jñānayajñena cāpyanye yajanto māmupāsate |
ekatvena pṛthaktvena bahudhā viśvatomukham ||
en: Others also, sacrificing with the sacrifice of wisdom, worship Me as the One and the Manifold everywhere present.
en_source: Besant 1922 (4th ed.) via en.wikisource [second-hand copy: Gita.AI]
en_swarupananda: Others, too, sacrificing by the Yajna of knowledge ( i.e. , seeing the Self in all), worship Me the All-Formed, as one, as distinct, as manifold.

speaker: krishna
sa:
अहं क्रतुरहं यज्ञः स्वधाऽहमहमौषधम् ।
मंत्रोऽहमहमेवाज्यमहमग्निरहं हुतम् ॥
iast_lib:
ahaṃ kraturahaṃ yajñaḥ svadhā'hamahamauṣadham |
maṃtro'hamahamevājyamahamagnirahaṃ hutam ||
en: I the ablation; I the sacrifice; I the ancestral offering; I the fire-giving herb; the mantram I; I also the butter; I the fire; the burnt-offering I;
en_source: Besant 1922 (4th ed.) via en.wikisource [second-hand copy: Gita.AI]
en_swarupananda: I am the Kratu, I the Yajna, I the Svadhâ, I the Aushadham, I the Mantra, I the Ajyam, I the fire, and I the oblation.

speaker: krishna
sa:
पिताऽहमस्य जगतो माता धाता पितामहः ।
वेद्यं पवित्रमोंकार ऋक् साम यजुरेव च ॥
sa_padas: वेद्यं पवित्रमोंकार ऋक् साम यजुरेव च
iast_lib:
pitā'hamasya jagato mātā dhātā pitāmahaḥ |
vedyaṃ pavitramoṃkāra ṛk sāma yajureva ca ||
en: I the Father of this universe, the Mother, the Supporter, the Grandsire, the Holy one to be known, the Word of Power, and also the Rik, Sâma, and Yajur,
en_source: Besant 1922 (4th ed.) via en.wikisource [second-hand copy: Gita.AI]
en_swarupananda: I am the Father of this world, the Mother, the Sustainer, the Grandfather; the Purifier, the (one) thing to be known, (the syllable) Om, and also the Rik, Sâman and Yajus.

speaker: krishna
sa:
गतिर्भर्ता प्रभुः साक्षी निवासः शरणं सुहृत् ।
प्रभवः प्रलयः स्थानं निधानं बीजमव्ययम् ॥
sa_padas: गतिर्भर्ता प्रभुः साक्षी निवासः शरणं सुहृत्
iast_lib:
gatirbhartā prabhuḥ sākṣī nivāsaḥ śaraṇaṃ suhṛt |
prabhavaḥ pralayaḥ sthānaṃ nidhānaṃ bījamavyayam ||
en: The Path, Husband, Lord, Witness, Abode, Shelter, Lover, Origin, Dissolution, Foundation, house, Seed imperishable.
en_source: Besant 1922 (4th ed.) via en.wikisource [second-hand copy: Gita.AI]
en_swarupananda: The Goal, the Supporter, the Lord, the Witness, the Abode, the Refuge, the Friend, the Origin, the Dissolution, the Substratum, the Storehouse, the Seed immutable.

speaker: krishna
sa:
तपाम्यहमहं वर्षं निगृह्णाम्युत्सृजामि च ।
अमृतं चैव मृत्युश्च सदसच्चाहमर्जुन ॥
iast_lib:
tapāmyahamahaṃ varṣaṃ nigṛhṇāmyutsṛjāmi ca |
amṛtaṃ caiva mṛtyuśca sadasaccāhamarjuna ||
en: I give heat; I hold back and send forth the rain; immortality and also death, being and non-being am I, Arjuna.
en_source: Besant 1922 (4th ed.) via en.wikisource [second-hand copy: Gita.AI]
en_swarupananda: (As sun) I give heat: I withhold and send forth rain; I am immortality and also death; being and non-being am I, O Arjuna!

speaker: krishna
sa:
त्रैविद्या मां सोमपाः पूतपापा
यज्ञैरिष्ट्वा स्वर्गतिं प्रार्थयन्ते ।
ते पुण्यमासाद्य सुरेन्द्रलोक
मश्नन्ति दिव्यान्दिवि देवभोगान् ॥
iast_lib:
traividyā māṃ somapāḥ pūtapāpā
yajñairiṣṭvā svargatiṃ prārthayante |
te puṇyamāsādya surendraloka
maśnanti divyāndivi devabhogān ||
en: The knowers of the three, the Soma-drinkers, the purified from sin, worshipping Me with sacrifice, pray of Me the way to heaven; they, ascending to the holy world of the Ruler of the Shining Ones, eat in heaven the divine feasts of the Shining Ones.
en_source: Besant 1922 (4th ed.) via en.wikisource [second-hand copy: Gita.AI]
en_swarupananda: The knowers of the three Vedas, worshipping Me by Yajna, drinking the Soma, and (thus) being purified from sin, pray for passage to heaven; reaching the holy world of the Lord of the Devas, they enjoy in heaven the divine pleasures of the Devas.

speaker: krishna
sa:
ते तं भुक्त्वा स्वर्गलोकं विशालं
क्षीणे पुण्ये मर्त्यलोकं विशन्ति ।
एव त्रयीधर्ममनुप्रपन्ना
गतागतं कामकामा लभन्ते ॥
iast_lib:
te taṃ bhuktvā svargalokaṃ viśālaṃ
kṣīṇe puṇye martyalokaṃ viśanti |
eva trayīdharmamanuprapannā
gatāgataṃ kāmakāmā labhante ||
en: They, having enjoyed the spacious heaven-world, their holiness withered, come back to this world of death. Following the virtues enjoined by the three, desiring desires, they obtain the transitory.
en_source: Besant 1922 (4th ed.) via en.wikisource [second-hand copy: Gita.AI]
en_swarupananda: Having enjoyed the vast Swarga-world, they enter the mortal world, on the exhaustion of their merit: Thus, abiding by the injunctions of the three (Vedas), desiring desires, they (constantly) come and go.

sa_review.why: A (base) is outvoted by agreeing independent witnesses
