readings.A: आहारस्त्वपि सर्वस्य त्रिविधो भवति प्रियः यज्ञस्तपस्तथा दानं तेषां भेदमिमं श्रृणु
readings.C: āhāras tv api sarvasya trividho bhavati priyaḥ yajñas tapas tathā dānaṃ teṣāṃ bhedam imaṃ śṛṇu
readings.D: āhārastvapi sarvasya trividho bhavati priyaḥ yajñastapastathā dānaṃ teṣāṃ bhedamimaṃ śṛṇu
readings.V: आहारस्त्वपि सर्वस्य त्रिविधो भवति प्रियः यज्ञस्तपस्तथा दानं तेषां भेदमिमं शृणु

speaker: krishna
sa:
आयुःसत्त्वबलारोग्यसुखप्रीतिविवर्धनाः ।
रस्याः स्निग्धाः स्थिरा हृद्या आहाराः सात्त्विकप्रियाः ॥
sa_padas: रस्याः स्निग्धाः स्थिरा हृद्या आहाराः सात्त्विकप्रियाः
iast_lib:
āyuḥsattvabalārogyasukhaprītivivardhanāḥ |
rasyāḥ snigdhāḥ sthirā hṛdyā āhārāḥ sāttvikapriyāḥ ||
en: The foods that augment vitality, energy, vigour, health, joy and cheerfulness, delicious, bland, substantial and agreeable, are dear to the pure.
en_source: Besant 1922 (4th ed.) via en.wikisource [second-hand copy: Gita.AI]
en_swarupananda: The foods which augment vitality, energy, strength, health, cheerfulness and appetite, which are savoury and oleaginous, substantial and agreeable , are liked by the Sâttvika.

speaker: krishna
sa:
कट्वम्ललवणात्युष्णतीक्ष्णरूक्षविदाहिनः ।
आहारा राजसस्येष्टा दुःखशोकामयप्रदाः ॥
iast_lib:
kaṭvamlalavaṇātyuṣṇatīkṣṇarūkṣavidāhinaḥ |
āhārā rājasasyeṣṭā duḥkhaśokāmayapradāḥ ||
en: The passionate desire foods that are bitter, sour, saline, over-hot, pungent, dry and burning and which produce pain, grief and sickness.
en_source: Besant 1922 (4th ed.) via en.wikisource [second-hand copy: Gita.AI]
en_swarupananda: The foods that are bitter, sour, saline, excessively hot, pungent, dry and burning, are liked by the Râjasika, and are productive of pain, grief and disease.

speaker: krishna
sa:
यातयामं गतरसं पूति पर्युषितं च यत् ।
उच्छिष्टमपि चामेध्यं भोजनं तामसप्रियम् ॥
sa_padas: यातयामं गतरसं पूति पर्युषितं च यत्
iast_lib:
yātayāmaṃ gatarasaṃ pūti paryuṣitaṃ ca yat |
ucchiṣṭamapi cāmedhyaṃ bhojanaṃ tāmasapriyam ||
en: That which is stale and flat, putrid and corrupt, leavings also and unclean, is the food dear to the dark.
en_source: Besant 1922 (4th ed.) via en.wikisource [second-hand copy: Gita.AI]
en_swarupananda: That which is stale, tasteless, stinking, cooked overnight, refuse and impure, is the food liked by the Tâmasika. [

speaker: krishna
sa:
अफलाकाङ्क्षिभिर्यज्ञो विधिदृष्टो य इज्यते ।
यष्टव्यमेवेति मनः समाधाय स सात्त्विकः ॥
iast_lib:
aphalākāṅkṣibhiryajño vidhidṛṣṭo ya ijyate |
yaṣṭavyameveti manaḥ samādhāya sa sāttvikaḥ ||
en: The sacrifice which is offered by men without desire for fruit, as enjoined by the ordinances, under the firm belief that sacrifice is a duty, that is pure.
en_source: Besant 1922 (4th ed.) via en.wikisource [second-hand copy: Gita.AI]
en_swarupananda: That Yajna is Sâttvika which is performed by men desiring no fruit, as enjoined by ordinance, with their mind fixed on the Yajna only, for its own sake.

speaker: krishna
sa:
अभिसंधाय तु फलं दम्भार्थमपि चैव यत् ।
इज्यते भरतश्रेष्ठ तं यज्ञं विद्धि राजसम् ॥
sa_padas: अभिसंधाय तु फलं दम्भार्थमपि चैव यत्
इज्यते भरतश्रेष्ठ तं यज्ञं विद्धि राजसम्
iast_lib:
abhisaṃdhāya tu phalaṃ dambhārthamapi caiva yat |
ijyate bharataśreṣṭha taṃ yajñaṃ viddhi rājasam ||
en: The sacrifice offered with a view verily to fruit, and also indeed for self-glorification, O best of the Bhâratas; know thou that to be of passion.
en_source: Besant 1922 (4th ed.) via en.wikisource [second-hand copy: Gita.AI]
en_swarupananda: That which is performed, O best of the Bhâratas, seeking for fruit and for ostentation, know it to be a Râjasika Yajna.

speaker: krishna
sa:
विधिहीनमसृष्टान्नं मन्त्रहीनमदक्षिणम् ।
श्रद्धाविरहितं यज्ञं तामसं परिचक्षते ॥
iast_lib:
vidhihīnamasṛṣṭānnaṃ mantrahīnamadakṣiṇam |
śraddhāvirahitaṃ yajñaṃ tāmasaṃ paricakṣate ||
en: The sacrifice contrary to the ordinances, without distributing food, devoid of words of power and without gifts, empty of faith, is said to be of darkness.
en_source: Besant 1922 (4th ed.) via en.wikisource [second-hand copy: Gita.AI]
en_swarupananda: The Yajna performed without heed to ordinance, in which no food is distributed, which is devoid of Mantras, gifts, and Shraddhâ, is said to be Tâmasika.

speaker: krishna
sa:
देवद्विजगुरुप्राज्ञपूजनं शौचमार्जवम् ।
ब्रह्मचर्यमहिंसा च शारीरं तप उच्यते ॥
iast_lib:
devadvijaguruprājñapūjanaṃ śaucamārjavam |
brahmacaryamahiṃsā ca śārīraṃ tapa ucyate ||
en: Worship given to the Gods, to the twice-born, to the teachers and to the wise, purity, straightforwardness, continence and harmlessness, are called the austerity of the body.
en_source: Besant 1922 (4th ed.) via en.wikisource [second-hand copy: Gita.AI]
en_swarupananda: Worship of the Devas, the twice-born, the Gurus and the wise, purity, straightforwardness, continence, and non-injury are called the austerity of the body.

speaker: krishna
sa:
अनुद्वेगकरं वाक्यं सत्यं प्रियहितं च यत् ।
स्वाध्यायाभ्यसनं चैव वाङ्मयं तप उच्यते ॥
sa_padas: अनुद्वेगकरं वाक्यं सत्यं प्रियहितं च यत्
iast_lib:
anudvegakaraṃ vākyaṃ satyaṃ priyahitaṃ ca yat |
svādhyāyābhyasanaṃ caiva vāṅmayaṃ tapa ucyate ||
en: Speech causing no annoyance, truthful, pleasant and beneficial, the practice of the study of the Scriptures, are called the austerity of speech.
en_source: Besant 1922 (4th ed.) via en.wikisource [second-hand copy: Gita.AI]
en_swarupananda: Speech which causes no vexation, and is true, as also agreeable and beneficial, and regular study of the Vedas,— these are said to form the austerity of speech.

speaker: krishna
sa:
मनःप्रसादः सौम्यत्वं मौनमात्मविनिग्रहः ।
भावसंशुद्धिरित्येतत्तपो मानसमुच्यते ॥
iast_lib:
manaḥprasādaḥ saumyatvaṃ maunamātmavinigrahaḥ |
bhāvasaṃśuddhirityetattapo mānasamucyate ||
en: Mental happiness, equilibrium, silence, self-control, purity of nature—these are called the austerity of the mind.
en_source: Besant 1922 (4th ed.) via en.wikisource [second-hand copy: Gita.AI]
en_swarupananda: Serenity of mind, kindliness, silence, self-control, honesty of motive,—this is called the mental austerity.

speaker: krishna
sa:
श्रद्धया परया तप्तं तपस्तत्त्रिविधं नरैः ।
अफलाकाङ्क्षिभिर्युक्तैः सात्त्विकं परिचक्षते ॥
iast_lib:
śraddhayā parayā taptaṃ tapastattrividhaṃ naraiḥ |
aphalākāṅkṣibhiryuktaiḥ sāttvikaṃ paricakṣate ||
en: This threefold austerity, performed by men with the utmost faith, without desire for fruit, harmonised, is said to be pure.
en_source: Besant 1922 (4th ed.) via en.wikisource [second-hand copy: Gita.AI]
en_swarupananda: This threefold austerity practised by steadfast men, with great Shraddhâ, desiring no fruit, is said to be Sâttvika.

speaker: krishna
sa:
सत्कारमानपूजार्थं तपो दम्भेन चैव यत् ।
क्रियते तदिह प्रोक्तं राजसं चलमध्रुवम् ॥
iast_lib:
satkāramānapūjārthaṃ tapo dambhena caiva yat |
kriyate tadiha proktaṃ rājasaṃ calamadhruvam ||
en: The austerity which is practised with the object of gaining respect, honour and worship, and for ostentation, is said to be of passion, unstable and fleeting.
en_source: Besant 1922 (4th ed.) via en.wikisource [second-hand copy: Gita.AI]
en_swarupananda: That austerity which is practised with the object of gaining welcome, honour and worship, and with ostentation, is here said to be Râjasika, unstable and transitory.

speaker: krishna
sa:
मूढग्राहेणात्मनो यत्पीडया क्रियते तपः ।
परस्योत्सादनार्थं वा तत्तामसमुदाहृतम् ॥
iast_lib:
mūḍhagrāheṇātmano yatpīḍayā kriyate tapaḥ |
parasyotsādanārthaṃ vā tattāmasamudāhṛtam ||
en: That austerity done under a deluded understanding, with self-torture, or with the object of destroying another, that is declared of darkness.
en_source: Besant 1922 (4th ed.) via en.wikisource [second-hand copy: Gita.AI]
en_swarupananda: That austerity which is practised out of a foolish notion, with self-torture or for the purpose of wining another, is declared to be Tâmasika.

speaker: krishna
sa:
दातव्यमिति यद्दानं दीयतेऽनुपकारिणे ।
देशे काले च पात्रे च तद्दानं सात्त्विकं स्मृतम् ॥
sa_padas: देशे काले च पात्रे च तद्दानं सात्त्विकं स्मृतम्
iast_lib:
dātavyamiti yaddānaṃ dīyate'nupakāriṇe |
deśe kāle ca pātre ca taddānaṃ sāttvikaṃ smṛtam ||
en: That alms given to one who does nothing in return, believing that a gift ought to be made in a fit place and time to a worthy person, that alms is accounted pure.
en_source: Besant 1922 (4th ed.) via en.wikisource [second-hand copy: Gita.AI]
en_swarupananda: To give is right, gift given with this idea, to one who does no service in return, in a fit place and to a worthy person, that gift is held to be Sâttvika.

speaker: krishna
sa:
यत्तु प्रत्युपकारार्थं फलमुद्दिश्य वा पुनः ।
दीयते च परिक्लिष्टं तद्दानं राजसं स्मृतम् ॥
sa_padas: दीयते च परिक्लिष्टं तद्दानं राजसं स्मृतम्
iast_lib:
yattu pratyupakārārthaṃ phalamuddiśya vā punaḥ |
dīyate ca parikliṣṭaṃ taddānaṃ rājasaṃ smṛtam ||
en: That given with a view to receiving in return, or looking for fruit again, or grudgingly, that alms is accounted of passion.
en_source: Besant 1922 (4th ed.) via en.wikisource [second-hand copy: Gita.AI]
en_swarupananda: And what is given with a view to receiving in return, or looking for the fruit, or again reluctantly, that gift is held to be Râjasika.

speaker: krishna
sa:
अदेशकाले यद्दानमपात्रेभ्यश्च दीयते ।
असत्कृतमवज्ञातं तत्तामसमुदाहृतम् ॥
iast_lib:
adeśakāle yaddānamapātrebhyaśca dīyate |
asatkṛtamavajñātaṃ tattāmasamudāhṛtam ||
en: That alms given at unfit place and time, and to unworthy persons, disrespectfully and contemptuously, that is declared of darkness.
en_source: Besant 1922 (4th ed.) via en.wikisource [second-hand copy: Gita.AI]
en_swarupananda: The gift that is given at the wrong place or time, to unworthy persons, without regard or with disdain, that is declared to be Tâmasika.

speaker: krishna
sa:
तत्सदिति निर्देशो ब्रह्मणस्त्रिविधः स्मृतः ।
ब्राह्मणास्तेन वेदाश्च यज्ञाश्च विहिताः पुरा ॥
iast_lib:
tatsaditi nirdeśo brahmaṇastrividhaḥ smṛtaḥ |
brāhmaṇāstena vedāśca yajñāśca vihitāḥ purā ||
en: " Aum Tat Sat," this has been considered to be the threefold designation of the Eternal. By that were ordained of old Brâhmanas, Vedas and sacrifices.
en_source: Besant 1922 (4th ed.) via en.wikisource [second-hand copy: Gita.AI]
en_swarupananda: "Om, Tat, Sat": this has been declared to be the triple designation of Brahman. By that were made of old the Brâhmanas, the Vedas and the Yajnas.

sa_review.why: A (base) is outvoted by agreeing independent witnesses

readings.A: तत्सदिति निर्देशो ब्रह्मणस्त्रिविधः स्मृतः ब्राह्मणास्तेन वेदाश्च यज्ञाश्च विहिताः पुरा
readings.C: oṃ tat sad iti nirdeśo brahmaṇas trividhaḥ smṛtaḥ brāhmaṇās tena vedāś ca yajñāś ca vihitāḥ purā
readings.D: oṃ tatsaditi nirdeśo brahmaṇastrividhaḥ smṛtaḥ brāhmaṇāstena vedāśca yajñāśca vihitāḥ purā
readings.V: ॐतत्सदिति निर्देशो ब्रह्मणस्त्रिविधः स्मृतः ब्राह्मणास्तेन वेदाश्च यज्ञाश्च विहिताः पुरा

speaker: krishna
sa:
तस्मादोमित्युदाहृत्य यज्ञदानतपःक्रियाः ।
प्रवर्तन्ते विधानोक्ताः सततं ब्रह्मवादिनाम् ॥
iast_lib:
tasmādomityudāhṛtya yajñadānatapaḥkriyāḥ |
pravartante vidhānoktāḥ satataṃ brahmavādinām ||
en: Therefore with the pronunciation of " Aum " the acts of sacrifice, gift and austerity as laid down in the ordinances are always commenced by the knowers of the Eternal.
en_source: Besant 1922 (4th ed.) via en.wikisource [second-hand copy: Gita.AI]
en_swarupananda: Therefore, uttering 'Om,' are the acts of sacrifice, gift and austerity as enjoined in the ordinances, always begun by the followers of the Vedas.

speaker: krishna
sa:
तदित्यनभिसन्धाय फलं यज्ञतपःक्रियाः ।
दानक्रियाश्च विविधाः क्रियन्ते मोक्षकाङ्क्षि ॥
iast_lib:
tadityanabhisandhāya phalaṃ yajñatapaḥkriyāḥ |
dānakriyāśca vividhāḥ kriyante mokṣakāṅkṣi ||
en: With the pronunciation of " Tat " and without aiming at fruit are performed the various acts of sacrifice, austerity and gift, by those desiring liberation.
en_source: Besant 1922 (4th ed.) via en.wikisource [second-hand copy: Gita.AI]
en_swarupananda: Uttering Tat, without aiming at fruits, are the various acts of Yajna, austerity and gift performed by the seekers of Moksha.

sa_review.why: A (base) is outvoted by agreeing independent witnesses

readings.A: तदित्यनभिसन्धाय फलं यज्ञतपःक्रियाः दानक्रियाश्च विविधाः क्रियन्ते मोक्षकाङ्क्षि
readings.C: tad ity anabhisaṃdhāya phalaṃ yajñatapaḥkriyāḥ dānakriyāś ca vividhāḥ kriyante mokṣakāṅkṣibhiḥ
readings.D: tadityanabhisaṃdhāya phalaṃ yajñatapaḥkriyāḥ dānakriyāśca vividhāḥ kriyante mokṣakāṅkṣibhiḥ
readings.V: तदित्यनभिसन्धाय फलं यज्ञतपःक्रियाः दानक्रियाश्च विविधाः क्रियन्ते मोक्षकाङ्क्षिभिः

speaker: krishna
sa:
सद्भावे साधुभावे च सदित्येतत्प्रयुज्यते ।
प्रशस्ते कर्मणि तथा सच्छब्दः पार्थ युज्यते ॥
sa_padas: प्रशस्ते कर्मणि तथा सच्छब्दः पार्थ युज्यते
iast_lib:
sadbhāve sādhubhāve ca sadityetatprayujyate |
praśaste karmaṇi tathā sacchabdaḥ pārtha yujyate ||
en: " Sat " is used in the sense of reality and goodness; likewise, O Pârtha, the word " Sat " is used in the sense of a good work.
en_source: Besant 1922 (4th ed.) via en.wikisource [second-hand copy: Gita.AI]
en_swarupananda: The word Sat is used in the sense of reality and of goodness; and so also, Pârtha, the word Sat is used in the sense of an auspicious act.

speaker: krishna
sa:
यज्ञे तपसि दाने च स्थितिः सदिति चोच्यते ।
कर्म चैव तदर्थीयं सदित्येवाभिधीयते ॥
sa_padas: यज्ञे तपसि दाने च स्थितिः सदिति चोच्यते
iast_lib:
yajñe tapasi dāne ca sthitiḥ saditi cocyate |
karma caiva tadarthīyaṃ sadityevābhidhīyate ||
en: Steadfastness in sacrifice, austerity and gift is also called " Sat ", and action for the sake of the Supreme is also named " Sat."
en_source: Besant 1922 (4th ed.) via en.wikisource [second-hand copy: Gita.AI]
en_swarupananda: Steadiness in Yajna, austerity and gift is also called 'Sat': as also action in connection with these (or, action for the sake of the Lord) is called Sat.

speaker: krishna
sa:
अश्रद्धया हुतं दत्तं तपस्तप्तं कृतं च यत् ।
असदित्युच्यते पार्थ न च तत्प्रेत्य नो इह ॥
sa_padas: अश्रद्धया हुतं दत्तं तपस्तप्तं कृतं च यत्
असदित्युच्यते पार्थ न च तत्प्रेत्य नो इह
iast_lib:
aśraddhayā hutaṃ dattaṃ tapastaptaṃ kṛtaṃ ca yat |
asadityucyate pārtha na ca tatpretya no iha ||
en: Whatsoever is wrought without faith, oblation, gift, austerity, or other deed, "Asat" it is called, O Pârtha; it is nought, here or hereafter.
en_source: Besant 1922 (4th ed.) via en.wikisource [second-hand copy: Gita.AI]
en_swarupananda: Whatever is sacrificed, given or performed, and whatever austerity is practised without Shraddhâ, it is called Asat, O Pârtha; it is naught here or hereafter.

speaker: arjuna
sa:
संन्यासस्य महाबाहो तत्त्वमिच्छामि वेदितुम् ।
त्यागस्य च हृषीकेश पृथक्केशिनिषूदन ॥
iast_lib:
saṃnyāsasya mahābāho tattvamicchāmi veditum |
tyāgasya ca hṛṣīkeśa pṛthakkeśiniṣūdana ||
en: Arjuna said: I desire, O mighty-armed, to know severally the essence of renunciation, O Hrishîkesha, and of relinquishment, O Keshinishûdana.
en_source: Besant 1922 (4th ed.) via en.wikisource [second-hand copy: Gita.AI]
en_swarupananda: I desire to know severally, O mighty-armed, the truth of Sannyâsa, O Hrishikesha, as also of Tyâga, O slayer of Keshi.

speaker: krishna
sa:
काम्यानां कर्मणां न्यासं संन्यासं कवयो विदुः ।
सर्वकर्मफलत्यागं प्राहुस्त्यागं विचक्षणाः ॥
sa_padas: काम्यानां कर्मणां न्यासं संन्यासं कवयो विदुः
iast_lib:
kāmyānāṃ karmaṇāṃ nyāsaṃ saṃnyāsaṃ kavayo viduḥ |
sarvakarmaphalatyāgaṃ prāhustyāgaṃ vicakṣaṇāḥ ||
en: The Blessed Lord said: Sages have known as renunciation the renouncing of works with desire; the relinquishing of the fruit of all actions is called relinquishment by the wise.
en_source: Besant 1922 (4th ed.) via en.wikisource [second-hand copy: Gita.AI]
en_swarupananda: The renunciation of Kâmya actions, the sages understand as. Sannyâsa: the wise declare the abandonment of the fruits of all works as Tyâga.

speaker: krishna
sa:
त्याज्यं दोषवदित्येके कर्म प्राहुर्मनीषिणः ।
यज्ञदानतपःकर्म न त्याज्यमिति चापरे ॥
iast_lib:
tyājyaṃ doṣavadityeke karma prāhurmanīṣiṇaḥ |
yajñadānatapaḥkarma na tyājyamiti cāpare ||
en: "Action should be relinquished as an evil," declare some thoughtful men; "acts of sacrifice, gift and austerity should not be relinquished," say others.
en_source: Besant 1922 (4th ed.) via en.wikisource [second-hand copy: Gita.AI]
en_swarupananda: Some philosophers declare that all action should be relinquished as an evil, whilst others (say) that the work of Yajna, gift and austerity should not be relinquished.

speaker: krishna
sa:
निश्चयं श्रृणु मे तत्र त्यागे भरतसत्तम ।
त्यागो हि पुरुषव्याघ्र त्रिविधः संप्रकीर्तितः ॥
sa_padas: निश्चयं श्रृणु मे तत्र त्यागे भरतसत्तम
iast_lib:
niścayaṃ śrṛṇu me tatra tyāge bharatasattama |
tyāgo hi puruṣavyāghra trividhaḥ saṃprakīrtitaḥ ||
en: Hear my conclusions as to that relinquishment, O best of the Bhâratas; since relinquishment, O tiger of men, has been explained as threefold.
en_source: Besant 1922 (4th ed.) via en.wikisource [second-hand copy: Gita.AI]
en_swarupananda: Hear from Me the final truth about relinquishment, O best of the Bhâratas. For relinquishment has been declared to be of three kinds, O tiger among men.

sa_review.why: A (base) is outvoted by agreeing independent witnesses

readings.A: निश्चयं श्रृणु मे तत्र त्यागे भरतसत्तम त्यागो हि पुरुषव्याघ्र त्रिविधः संप्रकीर्तितः
readings.C: niścayaṃ śṛṇu me tatra tyāge bharatasattama tyāgo hi puruṣavyāghra trividhaḥ saṃprakīrtitaḥ
readings.D: niścayaṃ śṛṇu me tatra tyāge bharatasattama tyāgo hi puruṣavyāghra trividhaḥ saṃprakīrtitaḥ
readings.V: निश्चयं शृणु मे तत्र त्यागे भरतसत्तम त्यागो हि पुरुषव्याघ्र त्रिविधः सम्प्रकीर्तितः

speaker: krishna
sa:
यज्ञदानतपःकर्म न त्याज्यं कार्यमेव तत् ।
यज्ञो दानं तपश्चैव पावनानि मनीषिणाम् ॥
iast_lib:
yajñadānatapaḥkarma na tyājyaṃ kāryameva tat |
yajño dānaṃ tapaścaiva pāvanāni manīṣiṇām ||
en: Acts of sacrifice, gift and austerity should not be relinquished, but should be performed; sacrifice, gift and also austerity are the purifiers of the intelligent.
en_source: Besant 1922 (4th ed.) via en.wikisource [second-hand copy: Gita.AI]
en_swarupananda: The work of Yajna, gift and austerity should not be relinquished, but it should indeed be performed; (for) Yajna, gift and austerity are purifying to the wise.

speaker: krishna
sa:
एतान्यपि तु कर्माणि सङ्गं त्यक्त्वा फलानि च ।
कर्तव्यानीति मे पार्थ निश्चितं मतमुत्तमम् ॥
sa_padas: एतान्यपि तु कर्माणि सङ्गं त्यक्त्वा फलानि च
iast_lib:
etānyapi tu karmāṇi saṅgaṃ tyaktvā phalāni ca |
kartavyānīti me pārtha niścitaṃ matamuttamam ||
en: But even these actions should be done leaving aside attachment and fruit, O Pârtha; that is my certain and best belief.
en_source: Besant 1922 (4th ed.) via en.wikisource [second-hand copy: Gita.AI]
en_swarupananda: But even these works, O Pârtha, should be performed, leaving attachment and the fruits;—such is My best and certain conviction.

speaker: krishna
sa:
नियतस्य तु संन्यासः कर्मणो नोपपद्यते ।
मोहात्तस्य परित्यागस्तामसः परिकीर्तितः ॥
iast_lib:
niyatasya tu saṃnyāsaḥ karmaṇo nopapadyate |
mohāttasya parityāgastāmasaḥ parikīrtitaḥ ||
en: Verily renunciation of actions that are prescribed is not proper; the relinquishment thereof from delusion is said to be of darkness.
en_source: Besant 1922 (4th ed.) via en.wikisource [second-hand copy: Gita.AI]
en_swarupananda: But the renunciation of obligatory action is not proper. Abandonment of the same from delusion is declared to be Tâmasika.

speaker: krishna
sa:
दुःखमित्येव यत्कर्म कायक्लेशभयात्त्यजेत् ।
स कृत्वा राजसं त्यागं नैव त्यागफलं लभेत् ॥
sa_padas: स कृत्वा राजसं त्यागं नैव त्यागफलं लभेत्
iast_lib:
duḥkhamityeva yatkarma kāyakleśabhayāttyajet |
sa kṛtvā rājasaṃ tyāgaṃ naiva tyāgaphalaṃ labhet ||
en: He who relinquisheth an action from fear of physical suffering, saying "Painful," thus performing a passionate relinquishment, obtaineth not the fruit of relinquishment.
en_source: Besant 1922 (4th ed.) via en.wikisource [second-hand copy: Gita.AI]
en_swarupananda: He who from fear of bodily trouble relinquishes action, because it is painful, thus performing a Râjasika relinquishment, he obtains not the fruit thereof.

speaker: krishna
sa:
कार्यमित्येव यत्कर्म नियतं क्रियतेऽर्जुन ।
सङ्गं त्यक्त्वा फलं चैव स त्यागः सात्त्विको मतः ॥
sa_padas: सङ्गं त्यक्त्वा फलं चैव स त्यागः सात्त्विको मतः
iast_lib:
kāryamityeva yatkarma niyataṃ kriyate'rjuna |
saṅgaṃ tyaktvā phalaṃ caiva sa tyāgaḥ sāttviko mataḥ ||
en: He who performeth a prescribed action, saying, "it ought to be done," O Arjuna, relinquishing attachment and also fruit, that relinquishment is regarded as pure.
en_source: Besant 1922 (4th ed.) via en.wikisource [second-hand copy: Gita.AI]
en_swarupananda: When obligatory work is performed, O Arjuna, only because it ought to be done, leaving attachment and fruit, such relinquishment is regarded as Sâttvika.

speaker: krishna
sa:
न द्वेष्ट्यकुशलं कर्म कुशले नानुषज्जते ।
त्यागी सत्त्वसमाविष्टो मेधावी छिन्नसंशयः ॥
iast_lib:
na dveṣṭyakuśalaṃ karma kuśale nānuṣajjate |
tyāgī sattvasamāviṣṭo medhāvī chinnasaṃśayaḥ ||
en: The relinquisher pervaded by purity, intelligent and with doubts cut away, hateth not unpleasurable action nor is attached to pleasurable.
en_source: Besant 1922 (4th ed.) via en.wikisource [second-hand copy: Gita.AI]
en_swarupananda: The relinquisher endued with Sattva and a steady understanding and with his doubts dispelled, hates not a disagreeable work nor is attached to an agreeable one.

speaker: krishna
sa:
न हि देहभृता शक्यं त्यक्तुं कर्माण्यशेषतः ।
यस्तु कर्मफलत्यागी स त्यागीत्यभिधीयते ॥
sa_padas: न हि देहभृता शक्यं त्यक्तुं कर्माण्यशेषतः
iast_lib:
na hi dehabhṛtā śakyaṃ tyaktuṃ karmāṇyaśeṣataḥ |
yastu karmaphalatyāgī sa tyāgītyabhidhīyate ||
en: Nor indeed can embodied beings completely relinquish action; verily he who relinquisheth the fruit of action, he is said to be a relinquisher.
en_source: Besant 1922 (4th ed.) via en.wikisource [second-hand copy: Gita.AI]
en_swarupananda: Actions cannot be entirely relinquished by an embodied being, but he who relinquishes the fruits of action is called a relinquisher.

speaker: krishna
sa:
अनिष्टमिष्टं मिश्रं च त्रिविधं कर्मणः फलम् ।
भवत्यत्यागिनां प्रेत्य न तु संन्यासिनां क्वचित् ॥
sa_padas: अनिष्टमिष्टं मिश्रं च त्रिविधं कर्मणः फलम्
भवत्यत्यागिनां प्रेत्य न तु संन्यासिनां क्वचित्
iast_lib:
aniṣṭamiṣṭaṃ miśraṃ ca trividhaṃ karmaṇaḥ phalam |
bhavatyatyāgināṃ pretya na tu saṃnyāsināṃ kvacit ||
en: Good, evil and mixed—threefold is the fruit of action hereafter for the non-relinquisher; but there is none ever for the renouncer.
en_source: Besant 1922 (4th ed.) via en.wikisource [second-hand copy: Gita.AI]
en_swarupananda: The threefold fruit of action—disagreeable, agreeable and mixed,—accrues to non-relinquishers after death, but never to relinquishers.

speaker: krishna
sa:
पञ्चैतानि महाबाहो कारणानि निबोध मे ।
सांख्ये कृतान्ते प्रोक्तानि सिद्धये सर्वकर्मणाम् ॥
iast_lib:
pañcaitāni mahābāho kāraṇāni nibodha me |
sāṃkhye kṛtānte proktāni siddhaye sarvakarmaṇām ||
en: These five causes, O mighty-armed, learn of Me as declared in the Sâñkhya system for the accomplishment of all actions:
en_source: Besant 1922 (4th ed.) via en.wikisource [second-hand copy: Gita.AI]
en_swarupananda: Learn from Me, O mighty-armed, these five causes for the accomplishment of all works as declared in the wisdom which is the end of all action:

speaker: krishna
sa:
अधिष्ठानं तथा कर्ता करणं च पृथग्विधम् ।
विविधाश्च पृथक्चेष्टा दैवं चैवात्र पञ्चमम् ॥
sa_padas: अधिष्ठानं तथा कर्ता करणं च पृथग्विधम्
iast_lib:
adhiṣṭhānaṃ tathā kartā karaṇaṃ ca pṛthagvidham |
vividhāśca pṛthakceṣṭā daivaṃ caivātra pañcamam ||
en: The body, the actor, the various organs, the diverse kinds of energies, and the presiding deities also, the fifth.
en_source: Besant 1922 (4th ed.) via en.wikisource [second-hand copy: Gita.AI]
en_swarupananda: The body, the agent, the various senses, the different functions of a manifold kind, and the presiding divinity, the fifth of these;

speaker: krishna
sa:
शरीरवाङ्मनोभिर्यत्कर्म प्रारभते नरः ।
न्याय्यं वा विपरीतं वा पञ्चैते तस्य हेतवः ॥
sa_padas: न्याय्यं वा विपरीतं वा पञ्चैते तस्य हेतवः
iast_lib:
śarīravāṅmanobhiryatkarma prārabhate naraḥ |
nyāyyaṃ vā viparītaṃ vā pañcaite tasya hetavaḥ ||
en: Whatever action a man performeth by his body, speech and mind, whether right or the reverse, these five are the cause thereof.
en_source: Besant 1922 (4th ed.) via en.wikisource [second-hand copy: Gita.AI]
en_swarupananda: Whatever action a man performs by his body, speech and mind—whether right or the reverse—these five are its causes.

speaker: krishna
sa:
तत्रैवं सति कर्तारमात्मानं केवलं तु यः ।
पश्यत्यकृतबुद्धित्वान्न स पश्यति दुर्मतिः ॥
sa_padas: तत्रैवं सति कर्तारमात्मानं केवलं तु यः
iast_lib:
tatraivaṃ sati kartāramātmānaṃ kevalaṃ tu yaḥ |
paśyatyakṛtabuddhitvānna sa paśyati durmatiḥ ||
en: That being so, he verily who—owing to untrained Reason—looketh on his Self, which is isolated, as the actor, he of perverted intelligence, seeth not.
en_source: Besant 1922 (4th ed.) via en.wikisource [second-hand copy: Gita.AI]
en_swarupananda: Such being the case, he who through a non-purified understanding looks upon his Self, the Absolute, as the agent, he of perverted mind sees not.

speaker: krishna
sa:
यस्य नाहंकृतो भावो बुद्धिर्यस्य न लिप्यते ।
हत्वापि स इमाँल्लोकान्न हन्ति न निबध्यते ॥
sa_padas: यस्य नाहंकृतो भावो बुद्धिर्यस्य न लिप्यते
हत्वापि स इमाँल्लोकान्न हन्ति न निबध्यते
iast_lib:
yasya nāhaṃkṛto bhāvo buddhiryasya na lipyate |
hatvāpi sa imā~llokānna hanti na nibadhyate ||
en: He who is free from the egoistic notion, whose Reason is not affected, though he slay these peoples, he slayeth not, nor is bound.
en_source: Besant 1922 (4th ed.) via en.wikisource [second-hand copy: Gita.AI]
en_swarupananda: He who is free from the notion of egoism, whose intelligence is not affected (by good or evil), though he kills these people, he kills not, nor is bound (by the action);

speaker: krishna
sa:
ज्ञानं ज्ञेयं परिज्ञाता त्रिविधा कर्मचोदना ।
करणं कर्म कर्तेति त्रिविधः कर्मसंग्रहः ॥
iast_lib:
jñānaṃ jñeyaṃ parijñātā trividhā karmacodanā |
karaṇaṃ karma karteti trividhaḥ karmasaṃgrahaḥ ||
en: Knowledge, the knowable and the knower, the threefold impulse to action; the organ, the action, the actor, the threefold constituents of action.
en_source: Besant 1922 (4th ed.) via en.wikisource [second-hand copy: Gita.AI]
en_swarupananda: Knowledge, the known and the knower form the threefold cause of action. The instrument, the object and the agent are the threefold basis of action.

speaker: krishna
sa:
ज्ञानं कर्म च कर्ता च त्रिधैव गुणभेदतः ।
प्रोच्यते गुणसंख्याने यथावच्छृणु तान्यपि ॥
sa_padas: ज्ञानं कर्म च कर्ता च त्रिधैव गुणभेदतः
iast_lib:
jñānaṃ karma ca kartā ca tridhaiva guṇabhedataḥ |
procyate guṇasaṃkhyāne yathāvacchṛṇu tānyapi ||
en: Knowledge, action and actor in the category of qualities are also said to be severally threefold, from the difference of qualities; hear thou duly these also.
en_source: Besant 1922 (4th ed.) via en.wikisource [second-hand copy: Gita.AI]
en_swarupananda: Knowledge, action and agent are declared in the Sânkhya philosophy to be of three kinds only, from the distinction of Gunas: hear them also duly.

speaker: krishna
sa:
सर्वभूतेषु येनैकं भावमव्ययमीक्षते ।
अविभक्तं विभक्तेषु तज्ज्ञानं विद्धि सात्त्विकम् ॥
iast_lib:
sarvabhūteṣu yenaikaṃ bhāvamavyayamīkṣate |
avibhaktaṃ vibhakteṣu tajjñānaṃ viddhi sāttvikam ||
en: That by which one indestructible Being is seen in all beings, inseparate in the separated, know thou that knowledge as pure.
en_source: Besant 1922 (4th ed.) via en.wikisource [second-hand copy: Gita.AI]
en_swarupananda: That by which the one indestructible Substance is seen in all beings, inseparate in the separated, know that knowledge to be Sâttvika.

speaker: krishna
sa:
पृथक्त्वेन तु यज्ज्ञानं नानाभावान्पृथग्विधान् ।
वेत्ति सर्वेषु भूतेषु तज्ज्ञानं विद्धि राजसम् ॥
sa_padas: वेत्ति सर्वेषु भूतेषु तज्ज्ञानं विद्धि राजसम्
iast_lib:
pṛthaktvena tu yajjñānaṃ nānābhāvānpṛthagvidhān |
vetti sarveṣu bhūteṣu tajjñānaṃ viddhi rājasam ||
en: But that knowledge which regardeth the several manifold existences in all beings as separate, that knowledge know thou as of passion;
en_source: Besant 1922 (4th ed.) via en.wikisource [second-hand copy: Gita.AI]
en_swarupananda: But that knowledge which sees in all beings various entities of distinct kinds as different from one another, know thou that knowledge as Râjasika.

speaker: krishna
sa:
यत्तु कृत्स्नवदेकस्मिन्कार्ये सक्तमहैतुकम् ।
अतत्त्वार्थवदल्पं च तत्तामसमुदाहृतम् ॥
iast_lib:
yattu kṛtsnavadekasminkārye saktamahaitukam |
atattvārthavadalpaṃ ca tattāmasamudāhṛtam ||
en: While that which clingeth to each one thing as if it were the whole, without reason, without grasping the reality, narrow, that is declared to be dark.
en_source: Besant 1922 (4th ed.) via en.wikisource [second-hand copy: Gita.AI]
en_swarupananda: Whilst that which is confined to one single effect as if it were the whole, without reason, without foundation in truth, and trivial,—that is declared to be Tâmasika.

speaker: krishna
sa:
नियतं सङ्गरहितमरागद्वेषतः कृतम् ।
अफलप्रेप्सुना कर्म यत्तत्सात्त्विकमुच्यते ॥
iast_lib:
niyataṃ saṅgarahitamarāgadveṣataḥ kṛtam |
aphalaprepsunā karma yattatsāttvikamucyate ||
en: An action which is ordained, done by one undesirous of fruit, devoid of attachment, without love or hate, that is called pure.
en_source: Besant 1922 (4th ed.) via en.wikisource [second-hand copy: Gita.AI]
en_swarupananda: An ordained action done without love or hatred by one not desirous of the fruit and free from attachment, is declared to be Sâttvika.

speaker: krishna
sa:
यत्तु कामेप्सुना कर्म साहङ्कारेण वा पुनः ।
क्रियते बहुलायासं तद्राजसमुदाहृतम् ॥
sa_padas: यत्तु कामेप्सुना कर्म साहङ्कारेण वा पुनः
iast_lib:
yattu kāmepsunā karma sāhaṅkāreṇa vā punaḥ |
kriyate bahulāyāsaṃ tadrājasamudāhṛtam ||
en: But that action that is done by one longing for desires, or again with egoism, or with much effort, that is declared to be passionate.
en_source: Besant 1922 (4th ed.) via en.wikisource [second-hand copy: Gita.AI]
en_swarupananda: But the action which is performed desiring desires, or with self-conceit and with much effort, is declared to be Râjasika.

speaker: krishna
sa:
अनुबन्धं क्षयं हिंसामनपेक्ष्य च पौरुषम् ।
मोहादारभ्यते कर्म यत्तत्तामसमुच्यते ॥
iast_lib:
anubandhaṃ kṣayaṃ hiṃsāmanapekṣya ca pauruṣam |
mohādārabhyate karma yattattāmasamucyate ||
en: The action undertaken from delusion, without regard to capacity and consequences—loss and injury to others—that is declared to be dark.
en_source: Besant 1922 (4th ed.) via en.wikisource [second-hand copy: Gita.AI]
en_swarupananda: That action is declared to be Tâmasika which is undertaken through delusion, without heed to the consequence, loss (of power and wealth), injury (to others) and (one's own) ability.

speaker: krishna
sa:
मुक्तसङ्गोऽनहंवादी धृत्युत्साहसमन्वितः ।
सिद्ध्यसिद्ध्योर्निर्विकारः कर्ता सात्त्विक उच्यते ॥
iast_lib:
muktasaṅgo'nahaṃvādī dhṛtyutsāhasamanvitaḥ |
siddhyasiddhyornirvikāraḥ kartā sāttvika ucyate ||
en: Liberated from attachment, not egoistic, endued with firmness and confidence, unchanged by success or failure, that actor is called pure.
en_source: Besant 1922 (4th ed.) via en.wikisource [second-hand copy: Gita.AI]
en_swarupananda: An agent who is free from attachment, non-egotistic, endued with fortitude and enthusiasm and unaffected in success or failure, is called Sâttvika.

speaker: krishna
sa:
रागी कर्मफलप्रेप्सुर्लुब्धो हिंसात्मकोऽशुचिः ।
हर्षशोकान्वितः कर्ता राजसः परिकीर्तितः ॥
iast_lib:
rāgī karmaphalaprepsurlubdho hiṃsātmako'śuciḥ |
harṣaśokānvitaḥ kartā rājasaḥ parikīrtitaḥ ||
en: Impassioned, desiring to obtain the fruit of actions, greedy, harmful, impure, moved by joy and sorrow, such an actor is pronounced passionate.
en_source: Besant 1922 (4th ed.) via en.wikisource [second-hand copy: Gita.AI]
en_swarupananda: He who is passionate, desirous of the fruits of action, greedy, malignant, impure, easily elated or dejected, such an agent is called Râjasika.

speaker: krishna
sa:
अयुक्तः प्राकृतः स्तब्धः शठो नैष्कृतिकोऽलसः ।
विषादी दीर्घसूत्री च कर्ता तामस उच्यते ॥
sa_padas: विषादी दीर्घसूत्री च कर्ता तामस उच्यते
iast_lib:
ayuktaḥ prākṛtaḥ stabdhaḥ śaṭho naiṣkṛtiko'lasaḥ |
viṣādī dīrghasūtrī ca kartā tāmasa ucyate ||
en: Discordant, vulgar, stubborn, cheating, malicious, indolent, despairful, procrastinating, that actor is called dark.
en_source: Besant 1922 (4th ed.) via en.wikisource [second-hand copy: Gita.AI]
en_swarupananda: Unsteady, vulgar, arrogant, dishonest, malicious, indolent, desponding and procrastinating, such an agent is called Tâmasika.

speaker: krishna
sa:
बुद्धेर्भेदं धृतेश्चैव गुणतस्त्रिविधं श्रृणु ।
प्रोच्यमानमशेषेण पृथक्त्वेन धनञ्जय ॥
iast_lib:
buddherbhedaṃ dhṛteścaiva guṇatastrividhaṃ śrṛṇu |
procyamānamaśeṣeṇa pṛthaktvena dhanañjaya ||
en: The division of Reason and of firmness also, threefold according to the qualities, hear thou related, unreservedly and severally, O Dhananjaya.
en_source: Besant 1922 (4th ed.) via en.wikisource [second-hand copy: Gita.AI]
en_swarupananda: Hear thou the triple distinction of intellect and fortitude, according to the Gunas, as I declare them exhaustively and severally, O Dhananjaya.

sa_review.why: A (base) is outvoted by agreeing independent witnesses

readings.A: बुद्धेर्भेदं धृतेश्चैव गुणतस्त्रिविधं श्रृणु प्रोच्यमानमशेषेण पृथक्त्वेन धनञ्जय
readings.C: buddher bhedaṃ dhṛteś caiva guṇatas trividhaṃ śṛṇu procyamānam aśeṣeṇa pṛthaktvena dhanaṃjaya
readings.D: buddherbhedaṃ dhṛteścaiva guṇatastrividhaṃ śṛṇu procyamānamaśeṣeṇa pṛthaktvena dhanaṃjaya
readings.V: बुद्धेर्भेदं धृतेश्चैव गुणतस्त्रिविधं शृणु प्रोच्यमानमशेषेण पृथक्त्वेन धनञ्जय

speaker: krishna
sa:
प्रवृत्तिं च निवृत्तिं च कार्याकार्ये भयाभये ।
बन्धं मोक्षं च या वेत्ति बुद्धिः सा पार्थ सात्त्विकी ॥
sa_padas: प्रवृत्तिं च निवृत्तिं च कार्याकार्ये भयाभये
बन्धं मोक्षं च या वेत्ति बुद्धिः सा पार्थ सात्त्विकी
iast_lib:
pravṛttiṃ ca nivṛttiṃ ca kāryākārye bhayābhaye |
bandhaṃ mokṣaṃ ca yā vetti buddhiḥ sā pārtha sāttvikī ||
en: That which knoweth energy and abstinence, what ought to be done and what ought not to be done, fear and fearlessness, bondage and liberation, that Reason is pure, O Pârtha.
en_source: Besant 1922 (4th ed.) via en.wikisource [second-hand copy: Gita.AI]
en_swarupananda: That which knows the paths of work and renunciation, right and wrong action, fear and fearlessness, bondage and liberation, that intellect, O Pârtha, is Sâttvika.

speaker: krishna
sa:
यया धर्ममधर्मं च कार्यं चाकार्यमेव च ।
अयथावत्प्रजानाति बुद्धिः सा पार्थ राजसी ॥
sa_padas: यया धर्ममधर्मं च कार्यं चाकार्यमेव च
iast_lib:
yayā dharmamadharmaṃ ca kāryaṃ cākāryameva ca |
ayathāvatprajānāti buddhiḥ sā pārtha rājasī ||
en: That by which one understandeth away Right and Wrong and also what ought to be done and what ought not to be done, that Reason, O Pârtha, is passionate.
en_source: Besant 1922 (4th ed.) via en.wikisource [second-hand copy: Gita.AI]
en_swarupananda: That which has a distorted apprehension of Dharma and its opposite and also of right action and its opposite, that intellect, O Pârtha, is Râjasika.

speaker: krishna
sa:
अधर्मं धर्ममिति या मन्यते तमसाऽऽवृता ।
सर्वार्थान्विपरीतांश्च बुद्धिः सा पार्थ तामसी ॥
iast_lib:
adharmaṃ dharmamiti yā manyate tamasā''vṛtā |
sarvārthānviparītāṃśca buddhiḥ sā pārtha tāmasī ||
en: That which, enwrapped in darkness, thinketh wrong to be right and seeth all things subverted, that Reason, O Pârtha, is of darkness.
en_source: Besant 1922 (4th ed.) via en.wikisource [second-hand copy: Gita.AI]
en_swarupananda: That which enveloped in darkness regards Adharma as Dharma and views all things in a perverted light, that intellect, O Pârtha, is Tâmasika.

speaker: krishna
sa:
धृत्या यया धारयते मनःप्राणेन्द्रियक्रियाः ।
योगेनाव्यभिचारिण्या धृतिः सा पार्थ सात्त्विकी ॥
iast_lib:
dhṛtyā yayā dhārayate manaḥprāṇendriyakriyāḥ |
yogenāvyabhicāriṇyā dhṛtiḥ sā pārtha sāttvikī ||
en: The unwavering firmness by which, through Yoga, one restraineth the activity of the mind, of the life breaths and of the sense-organs, that firmness, O Pârtha, is pure.
en_source: Besant 1922 (4th ed.) via en.wikisource [second-hand copy: Gita.AI]
en_swarupananda: The fortitude by which the functions of the mind, the Prâna and the senses, O Pârtha, are regulated, that fortitude, unswerving through Yoga, is Sâttvika.

speaker: krishna
sa:
यया तु धर्मकामार्थान् धृत्या धारयतेऽर्जुन ।
प्रसङ्गेन फलाकाङ्क्षी धृतिः सा पार्थ राजसी ॥
sa_padas: प्रसङ्गेन फलाकाङ्क्षी धृतिः सा पार्थ राजसी
iast_lib:
yayā tu dharmakāmārthān dhṛtyā dhārayate'rjuna |
prasaṅgena phalākāṅkṣī dhṛtiḥ sā pārtha rājasī ||
en: But the firmness, O Arjuna, by which, from attachment desirous of fruit, one holdeth fast duty, desire and wealth, that firmness, O Pârtha, is passionate.
en_source: Besant 1922 (4th ed.) via en.wikisource [second-hand copy: Gita.AI]
en_swarupananda: But the fortitude by which one regulates (one's mind) to Dharma, desire and wealth, desirous of the fruit of each from attachment, that fortitude, O Pârtha, is Râjasika.

speaker: krishna
sa:
यया स्वप्नं भयं शोकं विषादं मदमेव च ।
न विमुञ्चति दुर्मेधा धृतिः सा पार्थ तामसी ॥
sa_padas: यया स्वप्नं भयं शोकं विषादं मदमेव च
न विमुञ्चति दुर्मेधा धृतिः सा पार्थ तामसी
iast_lib:
yayā svapnaṃ bhayaṃ śokaṃ viṣādaṃ madameva ca |
na vimuñcati durmedhā dhṛtiḥ sā pārtha tāmasī ||
en: That by which one from stupidity doth not abandon sleep, fear, grief, despair, and also vanity, that firmness, O Pârtha, is dark.
en_source: Besant 1922 (4th ed.) via en.wikisource [second-hand copy: Gita.AI]
en_swarupananda: That by which a stupid man does not give up sleep, fear, grief, despondency and also overweening conceit, that fortitude, O Pârtha, is Tâmasika.

speaker: krishna
sa:
सुखं त्विदानीं त्रिविधं श्रृणु मे भरतर्षभ ।
अभ्यासाद्रमते यत्र दुःखान्तं च निगच्छति ॥
sa_padas: सुखं त्विदानीं त्रिविधं श्रृणु मे भरतर्षभ
iast_lib:
sukhaṃ tvidānīṃ trividhaṃ śrṛṇu me bharatarṣabha |
abhyāsādramate yatra duḥkhāntaṃ ca nigacchati ||
en: And now the threefold kinds of pleasure hear thou from Me, O bull of the Bhâratas. That in which one by practice rejoiceth, and which putteth an end to pain;
en_source: Besant 1922 (4th ed.) via en.wikisource [second-hand copy: Gita.AI]
en_swarupananda: And now hear from Me, O bull of the Bhâratas, of the threefold happiness. That happiness which one learns to enjoy by habit, and by which one comes to the end of pain;

sa_review.why: A (base) is outvoted by agreeing independent witnesses

readings.A: सुखं त्विदानीं त्रिविधं श्रृणु मे भरतर्षभ अभ्यासाद्रमते यत्र दुःखान्तं च निगच्छति
readings.C: sukhaṃ tv idānīṃ trividhaṃ śṛṇu me bharatarṣabha abhyāsād ramate yatra duḥkhāntaṃ ca nigacchhati
readings.D: sukhaṃ tvidānīṃ trividhaṃ śṛṇu me bharatarṣabha abhyāsādramate yatra duḥkhāntaṃ ca nigacchati
readings.V: सुखं त्विदानीं त्रिविधं शृणु मे भरतर्षभ अभ्यासाद्रमते यत्र दुःखान्तं च निगच्छति

speaker: krishna
sa:
यत्तदग्रे विषमिव परिणामेऽमृतोपमम् ।
तत्सुखं सात्त्विकं प्रोक्तमात्मबुद्धिप्रसादजम् ॥
iast_lib:
yattadagre viṣamiva pariṇāme'mṛtopamam |
tatsukhaṃ sāttvikaṃ proktamātmabuddhiprasādajam ||
en: Which at first is as venom but in the end is as nectar; that pleasure is said to be pure, born of the blissful knowledge of the Self.
en_source: Besant 1922 (4th ed.) via en.wikisource [second-hand copy: Gita.AI]
en_swarupananda: That which is like poison at first, but like nectar at the end; that happiness is declared to be Sâttvika, born of the translucence of intellect due to Self-realisation.

speaker: krishna
sa:
विषयेन्द्रियसंयोगाद्यत्तदग्रेऽमृतोपमम् ।
परिणामे विषमिव तत्सुखं राजसं स्मृतम् ॥
iast_lib:
viṣayendriyasaṃyogādyattadagre'mṛtopamam |
pariṇāme viṣamiva tatsukhaṃ rājasaṃ smṛtam ||
en: That which from the union of the senses with their objects at first is as nectar, but in the end is like venom, that pleasure is accounted passionate.
en_source: Besant 1922 (4th ed.) via en.wikisource [second-hand copy: Gita.AI]
en_swarupananda: That which arises from the contact of object with sense, at first like nectar, but at the end like poison, that happiness is declared to be Râjasika.

speaker: krishna
sa:
यदग्रे चानुबन्धे च सुखं मोहनमात्मनः ।
निद्रालस्यप्रमादोत्थं तत्तामसमुदाहृतम् ॥
iast_lib:
yadagre cānubandhe ca sukhaṃ mohanamātmanaḥ |
nidrālasyapramādotthaṃ tattāmasamudāhṛtam ||
en: That pleasure which both at first and afterwards is delusive of the self, arising from sleep, indolence and heedlessness, that is declared dark.
en_source: Besant 1922 (4th ed.) via en.wikisource [second-hand copy: Gita.AI]
en_swarupananda: That happiness which begins and results in self-delusion arising from sleep, indolence and miscomprehension, that is declared to be Tâmasika.

speaker: krishna
sa:
न तदस्ति पृथिव्यां वा दिवि देवेषु वा पुनः ।
सत्त्वं प्रकृतिजैर्मुक्तं यदेभिः स्यात्त्रिभिर्गुणैः ॥
sa_padas: न तदस्ति पृथिव्यां वा दिवि देवेषु वा पुनः
iast_lib:
na tadasti pṛthivyāṃ vā divi deveṣu vā punaḥ |
sattvaṃ prakṛtijairmuktaṃ yadebhiḥ syāttribhirguṇaiḥ ||
en: There is not an entity, either on the earth or again in heaven among the Shining Ones, that is liberated from these three qualities, born of Matter.
en_source: Besant 1922 (4th ed.) via en.wikisource [second-hand copy: Gita.AI]
en_swarupananda: There is no entity on earth, or again in heaven among the Devas, that is devoid of these three Gunas, born of Prakriti.

speaker: krishna
sa:
ब्राह्मणक्षत्रियविशां शूद्राणां च परंतप ।
कर्माणि प्रविभक्तानि स्वभावप्रभवैर्गुणैः ॥
iast_lib:
brāhmaṇakṣatriyaviśāṃ śūdrāṇāṃ ca paraṃtapa |
karmāṇi pravibhaktāni svabhāvaprabhavairguṇaiḥ ||
en: Of Brâhmanas, Kshattriyas, Vaishyas and Shûdras, O Parantapa, the duties have been distributed, according to the qualities born of their own natures.
en_source: Besant 1922 (4th ed.) via en.wikisource [second-hand copy: Gita.AI]
en_swarupananda: Of Brâhmanas and Kshatriyas and Vaishyas, as also of Sudras, O scorcher of foes, the duties are distributed according to the Gunas born of their own nature.

speaker: krishna
sa:
शमो दमस्तपः शौचं क्षान्तिरार्जवमेव च ।
ज्ञानं विज्ञानमास्तिक्यं ब्रह्मकर्म स्वभावजम् ॥
iast_lib:
śamo damastapaḥ śaucaṃ kṣāntirārjavameva ca |
jñānaṃ vijñānamāstikyaṃ brahmakarma svabhāvajam ||
en: Serenity, self-restraint, austerity, purity, forgiveness and also uprightness, wisdom, knowledge, belief in God, are the Brâhmana duty, born of his own nature.
en_source: Besant 1922 (4th ed.) via en.wikisource [second-hand copy: Gita.AI]
en_swarupananda: The control of the mind and the senses, austerity, purity, forbearance, and also uprightness, knowledge, realisation, belief in a hereafter,—these are the duties of the Brâhmanas, born of (their own) nature.

speaker: krishna
sa:
शौर्यं तेजो धृतिर्दाक्ष्यं युद्धे चाप्यपलायनम् ।
दानमीश्वरभावश्च क्षात्रं कर्म स्वभावजम् ॥
iast_lib:
śauryaṃ tejo dhṛtirdākṣyaṃ yuddhe cāpyapalāyanam |
dānamīśvarabhāvaśca kṣātraṃ karma svabhāvajam ||
en: Prowess, splendour, firmness, dexterity, and also not flying from battle, generosity, the nature of a ruler, are the Kshattriya duty, born of his own nature.
en_source: Besant 1922 (4th ed.) via en.wikisource [second-hand copy: Gita.AI]
en_swarupananda: Prowess, boldness, fortitude, dexterity, and also not flying from battle, generosity and sovereignty are the duties of the Kshatriyas, born of (their own) nature.

speaker: krishna
sa:
कृषिगौरक्ष्यवाणिज्यं वैश्यकर्म स्वभावजम् ।
परिचर्यात्मकं कर्म शूद्रस्यापि स्वभावजम् ॥
iast_lib:
kṛṣigaurakṣyavāṇijyaṃ vaiśyakarma svabhāvajam |
paricaryātmakaṃ karma śūdrasyāpi svabhāvajam ||
en: Ploughing, protection of kine, and trade are the Vaishya duty, born of his own nature. Action of the nature of service is the Shûdra duty, born of his own nature.
en_source: Besant 1922 (4th ed.) via en.wikisource [second-hand copy: Gita.AI]
en_swarupananda: Agriculture, cattle-rearing and trade are the duties of the Vaishyas, born of (their own) nature; and action consisting of service is the duty of the Sudras, born of (their own) nature.

speaker: krishna
sa:
स्वे स्वे कर्मण्यभिरतः संसिद्धिं लभते नरः ।
स्वकर्मनिरतः सिद्धिं यथा विन्दति तच्छृणु ॥
sa_padas: स्वे स्वे कर्मण्यभिरतः संसिद्धिं लभते नरः
iast_lib:
sve sve karmaṇyabhirataḥ saṃsiddhiṃ labhate naraḥ |
svakarmanirataḥ siddhiṃ yathā vindati tacchṛṇu ||
en: Man reacheth perfection by each being intent on his own duty. Listen thou how perfection is won by him who is intent on his own duty.
en_source: Besant 1922 (4th ed.) via en.wikisource [second-hand copy: Gita.AI]
en_swarupananda: Devoted each to his own duty, man attains the highest perfection. How engaged in his own duty, he attains perfection, that hear.

speaker: krishna
sa:
यतः प्रवृत्तिर्भूतानां येन सर्वमिदं ततम् ।
स्वकर्मणा तमभ्यर्च्य सिद्धिं विन्दति मानवः ॥
iast_lib:
yataḥ pravṛttirbhūtānāṃ yena sarvamidaṃ tatam |
svakarmaṇā tamabhyarcya siddhiṃ vindati mānavaḥ ||
en: He from whom is the emanation of beings, by Whom all This is pervaded, by worshipping Him in his own duty a man winneth perfection.
en_source: Besant 1922 (4th ed.) via en.wikisource [second-hand copy: Gita.AI]
en_swarupananda: From whom is the evolution of all beings, by whom all this is pervaded, worshipping Him with his own duty, a man attains perfection.

speaker: krishna
sa:
श्रेयान्स्वधर्मो विगुणः परधर्मात्स्वनुष्ठितात् ।
स्वभावनियतं कर्म कुर्वन्नाप्नोति किल्बिषम् ॥
iast_lib:
śreyānsvadharmo viguṇaḥ paradharmātsvanuṣṭhitāt |
svabhāvaniyataṃ karma kurvannāpnoti kilbiṣam ||
en: Better is one's own duty though destitute of merits than the well-executed duty of another. He who doeth the duty laid down by his own nature incurreth not sin.
en_source: Besant 1922 (4th ed.) via en.wikisource [second-hand copy: Gita.AI]
en_swarupananda: Better is one's own Dharma, (though) imperfect, than the Dharma of another well-performed. He who does the duty ordained by his own nature incurs no evil.

speaker: krishna
sa:
सहजं कर्म कौन्तेय सदोषमपि न त्यजेत् ।
सर्वारम्भा हि दोषेण धूमेनाग्निरिवावृताः ॥
sa_padas: सहजं कर्म कौन्तेय सदोषमपि न त्यजेत्
iast_lib:
sahajaṃ karma kaunteya sadoṣamapi na tyajet |
sarvārambhā hi doṣeṇa dhūmenāgnirivāvṛtāḥ ||
en: Congenital duty, O son of Kunti, though defective, ought not to be abandoned. All undertakings indeed are clouded by defects as fire by smoke.
en_source: Besant 1922 (4th ed.) via en.wikisource [second-hand copy: Gita.AI]
en_swarupananda: One should not relinquish, O son of Kunti, the duty to which one is born, though it is attended with evil; for, all undertakings are enveloped by evil, as fire by smoke.

speaker: krishna
sa:
असक्तबुद्धिः सर्वत्र जितात्मा विगतस्पृहः ।
नैष्कर्म्यसिद्धिं परमां संन्यासेनाधिगच्छति ॥
iast_lib:
asaktabuddhiḥ sarvatra jitātmā vigataspṛhaḥ |
naiṣkarmyasiddhiṃ paramāṃ saṃnyāsenādhigacchati ||
en: He whose Reason is everywhere unattached, the self-subdued, dead to desires, he goeth by renunciation to the supreme perfection of freedom from obligation.
en_source: Besant 1922 (4th ed.) via en.wikisource [second-hand copy: Gita.AI]
en_swarupananda: He whose intellect is unattached everywhere, who has subdued his heart, whose desires have fled, he attains by renunciation to the supreme perfection, consisting of freedom from action.

speaker: krishna
sa:
सिद्धिं प्राप्तो यथा ब्रह्म तथाप्नोति निबोध मे ।
समासेनैव कौन्तेय निष्ठा ज्ञानस्य या परा ॥
sa_padas: सिद्धिं प्राप्तो यथा ब्रह्म तथाप्नोति निबोध मे
समासेनैव कौन्तेय निष्ठा ज्ञानस्य या परा
iast_lib:
siddhiṃ prāpto yathā brahma tathāpnoti nibodha me |
samāsenaiva kaunteya niṣṭhā jñānasya yā parā ||
en: How he who hath attained perfection obtaineth the Eternal, that highest state of wisdom, learn thou from Me only succinctly, O Kaunteya.
en_source: Besant 1922 (4th ed.) via en.wikisource [second-hand copy: Gita.AI]
en_swarupananda: Learn from Me in brief, O son of Kunti, how reaching such perfection, he attains to Brahman, that supreme consummation of knowledge.

speaker: krishna
sa:
बुद्ध्या विशुद्धया युक्तो धृत्याऽऽत्मानं नियम्य च ।
शब्दादीन् विषयांस्त्यक्त्वा रागद्वेषौ व्युदस्य च ॥
sa_padas: बुद्ध्या विशुद्धया युक्तो धृत्याऽऽत्मानं नियम्य च
iast_lib:
buddhyā viśuddhayā yukto dhṛtyā''tmānaṃ niyamya ca |
śabdādīn viṣayāṃstyaktvā rāgadveṣau vyudasya ca ||
en: United to this Reason, purified, controlling the self by firmness, having abandoned sound and the other objects of the senses, having laid aside passion and malice,
en_source: Besant 1922 (4th ed.) via en.wikisource [second-hand copy: Gita.AI]
en_swarupananda: Endued with a pure intellect, subduing the body and the senses with fortitude, relinquishing sound and such other sense-objects, abandoning attraction and hatred;

speaker: krishna
sa:
विविक्तसेवी लघ्वाशी यतवाक्कायमानसः ।
ध्यानयोगपरो नित्यं वैराग्यं समुपाश्रितः ॥
iast_lib:
viviktasevī laghvāśī yatavākkāyamānasaḥ |
dhyānayogaparo nityaṃ vairāgyaṃ samupāśritaḥ ||
en: Dwelling in solitude, abstemious, speech, body and mind subdued, constantly fixed in meditation and yoga, taking refuge in dispassion,
en_source: Besant 1922 (4th ed.) via en.wikisource [second-hand copy: Gita.AI]
en_swarupananda: Resorting to a sequestered spot, eating but little, body, speech and mind controlled, ever engaged in meditation and concentration, possessed of dispassion;

speaker: krishna
sa:
अहङ्कारं बलं दर्पं कामं क्रोधं परिग्रहम् ।
विमुच्य निर्ममः शान्तो ब्रह्मभूयाय कल्पते ॥
sa_padas: अहङ्कारं बलं दर्पं कामं क्रोधं परिग्रहम्
iast_lib:
ahaṅkāraṃ balaṃ darpaṃ kāmaṃ krodhaṃ parigraham |
vimucya nirmamaḥ śānto brahmabhūyāya kalpate ||
en: Having cast aside egoism, violence, arrogance, desire, wrath, covetousness, selfless and peaceful—he is fit to become the Eternal.
en_source: Besant 1922 (4th ed.) via en.wikisource [second-hand copy: Gita.AI]
en_swarupananda: Forsaking egoism, power, pride, lust, wrath and property, freed from the notion of "mine," and tranquil, he is fit for becoming Brahman.

speaker: krishna
sa:
ब्रह्मभूतः प्रसन्नात्मा न शोचति न काङ्क्षति ।
समः सर्वेषु भूतेषु मद्भक्तिं लभते पराम् ॥
sa_padas: ब्रह्मभूतः प्रसन्नात्मा न शोचति न काङ्क्षति
समः सर्वेषु भूतेषु मद्भक्तिं लभते पराम्
iast_lib:
brahmabhūtaḥ prasannātmā na śocati na kāṅkṣati |
samaḥ sarveṣu bhūteṣu madbhaktiṃ labhate parām ||
en: Becoming the Eternal, serene in the Self, he neither grieveth nor desireth; the same to all beings, he obtaineth supreme devotion unto Me.
en_source: Besant 1922 (4th ed.) via en.wikisource [second-hand copy: Gita.AI]
en_swarupananda: Brahman-become, tranquil-minded, he neither grieves nor desires; the same to all beings, he attains to supreme devotion unto Me.

speaker: krishna
sa:
भक्त्या मामभिजानाति यावान्यश्चास्मि तत्त्वतः ।
ततो मां तत्त्वतो ज्ञात्वा विशते तदनन्तरम् ॥
sa_padas: ततो मां तत्त्वतो ज्ञात्वा विशते तदनन्तरम्
iast_lib:
bhaktyā māmabhijānāti yāvānyaścāsmi tattvataḥ |
tato māṃ tattvato jñātvā viśate tadanantaram ||
en: By devotion he knoweth Me in essence, who and what I am; having thus known Me in essence he forthwith entereth into the Supreme.
en_source: Besant 1922 (4th ed.) via en.wikisource [second-hand copy: Gita.AI]
en_swarupananda: By devotion he knows Me in reality, what and who I am; then having known Me in reality, he forthwith enters into Me.

speaker: krishna
sa:
सर्वकर्माण्यपि सदा कुर्वाणो मद्व्यपाश्रयः ।
मत्प्रसादादवाप्नोति शाश्वतं पदमव्ययम् ॥
iast_lib:
sarvakarmāṇyapi sadā kurvāṇo madvyapāśrayaḥ |
matprasādādavāpnoti śāśvataṃ padamavyayam ||
en: Though ever performing all actions, taking refuge in Me, by My grace he obtaineth the eternal indestructible abode.
en_source: Besant 1922 (4th ed.) via en.wikisource [second-hand copy: Gita.AI]
en_swarupananda: Even doing all actions always, taking refuge in Me,—by My grace he attains to the eternal, immutable State.

speaker: krishna
sa:
चेतसा सर्वकर्माणि मयि संन्यस्य मत्परः ।
बुद्धियोगमुपाश्रित्य मच्चित्तः सततं भव ॥
iast_lib:
cetasā sarvakarmāṇi mayi saṃnyasya matparaḥ |
buddhiyogamupāśritya maccittaḥ satataṃ bhava ||
en: Renouncing mentally all works in Me, intent on Me, resorting to the yoga of discrimination, have thy thought ever on Me.
en_source: Besant 1922 (4th ed.) via en.wikisource [second-hand copy: Gita.AI]
en_swarupananda: Resigning mentally all deeds to Me, having Me as the highest goal, resorting to Buddhi-Yoga do thou ever fix thy mind on Me.

speaker: krishna
sa:
मच्चित्तः सर्वदुर्गाणि मत्प्रसादात्तरिष्यसि ।
अथ चेत्त्वमहङ्कारान्न श्रोष्यसि विनङ्क्ष्यसि ॥
iast_lib:
maccittaḥ sarvadurgāṇi matprasādāttariṣyasi |
atha cettvamahaṅkārānna śroṣyasi vinaṅkṣyasi ||
en: Thinking on Me, thou shalt overcome all obstacles by My grace: but if from egoism thou wilt not listen, thou shalt be destroyed utterly.
en_source: Besant 1922 (4th ed.) via en.wikisource [second-hand copy: Gita.AI]
en_swarupananda: Fixing thy mind on Me, thou shalt, by My grace, overcome all obstacles; but if from self-conceit thou wilt not hear Me, thou shalt perish.

speaker: krishna
sa:
यदहङ्कारमाश्रित्य न योत्स्य इति मन्यसे ।
मिथ्यैष व्यवसायस्ते प्रकृतिस्त्वां नियोक्ष्यति ॥
iast_lib:
yadahaṅkāramāśritya na yotsya iti manyase |
mithyaiṣa vyavasāyaste prakṛtistvāṃ niyokṣyati ||
en: Entrenched in egoism, thou thinkest, "I will not fight;" to no purpose thy determination; nature will constrain thee.
en_source: Besant 1922 (4th ed.) via en.wikisource [second-hand copy: Gita.AI]
en_swarupananda: If filled with self-conceit thou thinkest, "I will not fight," vain is this thy resolve; thy Prakriti will constrain thee.

speaker: krishna
sa:
स्वभावजेन कौन्तेय निबद्धः स्वेन कर्मणा ।
कर्तुं नेच्छसि यन्मोहात्करिष्यस्यवशोऽपि तत् ॥
iast_lib:
svabhāvajena kaunteya nibaddhaḥ svena karmaṇā |
kartuṃ necchasi yanmohātkariṣyasyavaśo'pi tat ||
en: O son of Kuntî, bound by thine own duty born of thine own nature, that which from delusion thou desirest not to do, even that helplessly thou shalt perform.
en_source: Besant 1922 (4th ed.) via en.wikisource [second-hand copy: Gita.AI]
en_swarupananda: Fettered, O son of Kunti, by thy own Karma, born of thy own nature, what thou, from delusion, desirest not to do, thou shalt have to do in spite of thyself.

speaker: krishna
sa:
ईश्वरः सर्वभूतानां हृद्देशेऽर्जुन तिष्ठति ।
भ्रामयन्सर्वभूतानि यन्त्रारूढानि मायया ॥
iast_lib:
īśvaraḥ sarvabhūtānāṃ hṛddeśe'rjuna tiṣṭhati |
bhrāmayansarvabhūtāni yantrārūḍhāni māyayā ||
en: The Lord dwelleth in the hearts of all beings, O Arjuna, by His illusive Power causing all beings to revolve, as though mounted on a potter's wheel.
en_source: Besant 1922 (4th ed.) via en.wikisource [second-hand copy: Gita.AI]
en_swarupananda: The Lord, O Arjuna, dwells in the hearts of all beings, causing all beings, by His Mâyâ, to revolve, (as if) mounted on a machine.

speaker: krishna
sa:
तमेव शरणं गच्छ सर्वभावेन भारत ।
तत्प्रसादात्परां शान्तिं स्थानं प्राप्स्यसि शाश्वतम् ॥
iast_lib:
tameva śaraṇaṃ gaccha sarvabhāvena bhārata |
tatprasādātparāṃ śāntiṃ sthānaṃ prāpsyasi śāśvatam ||
en: Flee unto Him for shelter with all thy being, O Bhârata; by His grace thou shalt obtain supreme peace, the everlasting dwelling-place.
en_source: Besant 1922 (4th ed.) via en.wikisource [second-hand copy: Gita.AI]
en_swarupananda: Take refuge in Him with all thy heart, O Bhârata; by His grace shalt thou attain supreme peace (and) the eternal abode.

speaker: krishna
sa:
इति ते ज्ञानमाख्यातं गुह्याद्गुह्यतरं मया ।
विमृश्यैतदशेषेण यथेच्छसि तथा कुरु ॥
iast_lib:
iti te jñānamākhyātaṃ guhyādguhyataraṃ mayā |
vimṛśyaitadaśeṣeṇa yathecchasi tathā kuru ||
en: Thus hath wisdom, more secret than secrecy itself, been declared unto thee by Me; having reflected on it fully, then act thou as thou listest.
en_source: Besant 1922 (4th ed.) via en.wikisource [second-hand copy: Gita.AI]
en_swarupananda: Thus has wisdom more profound than all profundities, been declared to. thee by Me; reflecting over it fully, act as thou likest.

speaker: krishna
sa:
सर्वगुह्यतमं भूयः श्रृणु मे परमं वचः ।
इष्टोऽसि मे दृढमिति ततो वक्ष्यामि ते हितम् ॥
sa_padas: सर्वगुह्यतमं भूयः श्रृणु मे परमं वचः
इष्टोऽसि मे दृढमिति ततो वक्ष्यामि ते हितम्
iast_lib:
sarvaguhyatamaṃ bhūyaḥ śrṛṇu me paramaṃ vacaḥ |
iṣṭo'si me dṛḍhamiti tato vakṣyāmi te hitam ||
en: Listen thou again to My supreme word, most secret of all; beloved art thou of Me, and steadfast of heart, therefore will I speak for thy benefit.
en_source: Besant 1922 (4th ed.) via en.wikisource [second-hand copy: Gita.AI]
en_swarupananda: Hear thou again My supreme word, the profoundest of all; because thou art dearly beloved of Me, therefore will I speak what is good to thee.

sa_review.why: A (base) is outvoted by agreeing independent witnesses

readings.A: सर्वगुह्यतमं भूयः श्रृणु मे परमं वचः इष्टोऽसि मे दृढमिति ततो वक्ष्यामि ते हितम्
readings.C: sarvaguhyatamaṃ bhūyaḥ śṛṇu me paramaṃ vacaḥ iṣṭosi me dṛḍham iti tato vakṣyāmi te hitam
readings.D: sarvaguhyatamaṃ bhūyaḥ śṛṇu me paramaṃ vacaḥ iṣṭo 'si me dṛḍhamiti tato vakṣyāmi te hitam
readings.V: सर्वगुह्यतमं भूयः शृणु मे परमं वचः इष्टोऽसि मे दृढमिति ततो वक्ष्यामि ते हितम्

speaker: krishna
sa:
मन्मना भव मद्भक्तो मद्याजी मां नमस्कुरु ।
मामेवैष्यसि सत्यं ते प्रतिजाने प्रियोऽसि मे ॥
sa_padas: मन्मना भव मद्भक्तो मद्याजी मां नमस्कुरु
मामेवैष्यसि सत्यं ते प्रतिजाने प्रियोऽसि मे
iast_lib:
manmanā bhava madbhakto madyājī māṃ namaskuru |
māmevaiṣyasi satyaṃ te pratijāne priyo'si me ||
en: Merge thy mind in Me, be my devotee, sacrifice to Me, prostrate thyself before Me, thou shalt come even to Me. I pledge thee My troth; thou art dear to Me.
en_source: Besant 1922 (4th ed.) via en.wikisource [second-hand copy: Gita.AI]
en_swarupananda: Occupy thy mind with Me, be devoted to Me, sacrifice to Me, bow down to Me. Thou shalt reach Myself; truly do I promise unto thee, (for) thou art dear to Me.

speaker: krishna
sa:
सर्वधर्मान्परित्यज्य मामेकं शरणं व्रज ।
अहं त्वा सर्वपापेभ्यो मोक्षयिष्यामि मा शुचः ॥
sa_padas: अहं त्वा सर्वपापेभ्यो मोक्षयिष्यामि मा शुचः
iast_lib:
sarvadharmānparityajya māmekaṃ śaraṇaṃ vraja |
ahaṃ tvā sarvapāpebhyo mokṣayiṣyāmi mā śucaḥ ||
en: Abandoning all duties come unto Me alone for shelter; sorrow not, I will liberate thee from all sins.
en_source: Besant 1922 (4th ed.) via en.wikisource [second-hand copy: Gita.AI]
en_swarupananda: Relinquishing all Dharmas take refuge in Me alone; I will liberate thee from all sins; grieve not.

speaker: krishna
sa:
इदं ते नातपस्काय नाभक्ताय कदाचन ।
न चाशुश्रूषवे वाच्यं न च मां योऽभ्यसूयति ॥
sa_padas: न चाशुश्रूषवे वाच्यं न च मां योऽभ्यसूयति
iast_lib:
idaṃ te nātapaskāya nābhaktāya kadācana |
na cāśuśrūṣave vācyaṃ na ca māṃ yo'bhyasūyati ||
en: Never is this to be spoken by thee to anyone who is without asceticism, nor without devotion, nor to one who desireth not to listen, nor yet to him who speaketh evil of Me.
en_source: Besant 1922 (4th ed.) via en.wikisource [second-hand copy: Gita.AI]
en_swarupananda: This is never to be spoken by thee to one who is devoid of austerities or devotion, nor to one who does not render service, nor to one who cavils at Me.

speaker: krishna
sa:
य इमं परमं गुह्यं मद्भक्तेष्वभिधास्यति ।
भक्तिं मयि परां कृत्वा मामेवैष्यत्यसंशयः ॥
iast_lib:
ya imaṃ paramaṃ guhyaṃ madbhakteṣvabhidhāsyati |
bhaktiṃ mayi parāṃ kṛtvā māmevaiṣyatyasaṃśayaḥ ||
en: He who shall declare this supreme secret among My devotees, having shown the highest devotion for Me, without doubt he shall come to Me.
en_source: Besant 1922 (4th ed.) via en.wikisource [second-hand copy: Gita.AI]
en_swarupananda: He who with supreme devotion to Me will teach this deeply profound philosophy to My devotees, shall doubtless come to Me alone.

sa_review.why: A (base) is outvoted by agreeing independent witnesses

readings.A: य इमं परमं गुह्यं मद्भक्तेष्वभिधास्यति भक्तिं मयि परां कृत्वा मामेवैष्यत्यसंशयः
readings.C: ya idaṃ paramaṃ guhyaṃ madbhakteṣv abhidhāsyati bhaktiṃ mayi parāṃ kṛtvā mām evaiṣyaty asaṃśayaḥ
readings.D: ya idaṃ paramaṃ guhyaṃ madbhakteṣvabhidhāsyati bhaktiṃ mayi parāṃ kṛtvā māmevaiṣyatyasaṃśayaḥ
readings.V: य इदं परमं गुह्यं मद्भक्तेष्वभिधास्यति भक्तिं मयि परां कृत्वा मामेवैष्यत्यसंशयः

speaker: krishna
sa:
न च तस्मान्मनुष्येषु कश्चिन्मे प्रियकृत्तमः ।
भविता न च मे तस्मादन्यः प्रियतरो भुवि ॥
sa_padas: भविता न च मे तस्मादन्यः प्रियतरो भुवि
iast_lib:
na ca tasmānmanuṣyeṣu kaścinme priyakṛttamaḥ |
bhavitā na ca me tasmādanyaḥ priyataro bhuvi ||
en: Nor is there any among men who performeth dearer service to Me than he, nor any other shall be more beloved by Me on earth than he.
en_source: Besant 1922 (4th ed.) via en.wikisource [second-hand copy: Gita.AI]
en_swarupananda: Nor among men is there any who does dearer service to Me, nor shall there be another on earth dearer to Me, than he.

speaker: krishna
sa:
अध्येष्यते च य इमं धर्म्यं संवादमावयोः ।
ज्ञानयज्ञेन तेनाहमिष्टः स्यामिति मे मतिः ॥
sa_padas: अध्येष्यते च य इमं धर्म्यं संवादमावयोः
iast_lib:
adhyeṣyate ca ya imaṃ dharmyaṃ saṃvādamāvayoḥ |
jñānayajñena tenāhamiṣṭaḥ syāmiti me matiḥ ||
en: And he who shall study this sacred dialogue of ours, by him I shall be worshipped with the sacrifice of wisdom. Such is My mind.
en_source: Besant 1922 (4th ed.) via en.wikisource [second-hand copy: Gita.AI]
en_swarupananda: And he who will study this sacred dialogue of ours, by him shall I have been worshipped by the Yajna of knowledge; such is My conviction.

speaker: krishna
sa:
श्रद्धावाननसूयश्च श्रृणुयादपि यो नरः ।
सोऽपि मुक्तः शुभाँल्लोकान्प्राप्नुयात्पुण्यकर्मणाम् ॥
iast_lib:
śraddhāvānanasūyaśca śrṛṇuyādapi yo naraḥ |
so'pi muktaḥ śubhā~llokānprāpnuyātpuṇyakarmaṇām ||
en: The man also who, full of faith, merely heareth it unreviling, even he, freed from evil, obtaineth the radiant worlds of the righteous.
en_source: Besant 1922 (4th ed.) via en.wikisource [second-hand copy: Gita.AI]
en_swarupananda: And even that man who hears this, full of Shraddhâ and free from malice, he too, liberated, shall attain to the happy worlds of those of righteous deeds.

readings.A: श्रद्धावाननसूयश्च श्रृणुयादपि यो नरः सोऽपि मुक्तः शुभाँल्लोकान्प्राप्नुयात्पुण्यकर्मणाम्
readings.C: śraddhāvān anasūyaś ca śṛṇuyād api yo naraḥ sopi muktaḥ śubhāṃl lokān prāpnuyāt puṇyakarmaṇām
readings.D: śraddhāvān anasūyaś ca śṛṇuyādapi yo naraḥ so 'pi muktaḥ śubhāṃllokānprāpnuyātpuṇyakarmaṇām
readings.V: श्रद्धावाननसूयश्च शृणुयादपि यो नरः सोऽपि मुक्तः शुभाँल्लोकान्प्राप्नुयात्पुण्यकर्मणाम्

speaker: krishna
sa:
कच्चिदेतच्छ्रुतं पार्थ त्वयैकाग्रेण चेतसा ।
कच्चिदज्ञानसंमोहः प्रनष्टस्ते धनञ्जय ॥
iast_lib:
kaccidetacchrutaṃ pārtha tvayaikāgreṇa cetasā |
kaccidajñānasaṃmohaḥ pranaṣṭaste dhanañjaya ||
en: Hath this been heard, O son of Prithâ, with one-pointed mind? Has thy delusion, caused by unwisdom, been destroyed, O Dhananjaya?
en_source: Besant 1922 (4th ed.) via en.wikisource [second-hand copy: Gita.AI]
en_swarupananda: Has this been heard by thee, Pârtha, with an attentive mind? Has the delusion of thy ignorance been destroyed, O Dhananjaya?

speaker: arjuna
sa:
नष्टो मोहः स्मृतिर्लब्धा त्वत्प्रसादान्मयाच्युत ।
स्थितोऽस्मि गतसन्देहः करिष्ये वचनं तव ॥
iast_lib:
naṣṭo mohaḥ smṛtirlabdhā tvatprasādānmayācyuta |
sthito'smi gatasandehaḥ kariṣye vacanaṃ tava ||
en: Arjuna said: Destroyed is my delusion. I have gained knowledge through Thy grace, O Immutable one. I am firm, my doubts have fled away. I will do according to Thy word.
en_source: Besant 1922 (4th ed.) via en.wikisource [second-hand copy: Gita.AI]
en_swarupananda: Destroyed is my delusion, and I have gained my memory through Thy grace, O Achyuta. I am firm; my doubts are gone. I will do Thy word.

speaker: sanjaya
sa:
इत्यहं वासुदेवस्य पार्थस्य च महात्मनः ।
संवादमिममश्रौषमद्भुतं रोमहर्षणम् ॥
iast_lib:
ityahaṃ vāsudevasya pārthasya ca mahātmanaḥ |
saṃvādamimamaśrauṣamadbhutaṃ romaharṣaṇam ||
en: Sanjaya said: I heard this marvellous dialogue of Vâsudeva, and of the great-souled Partha, causing my hair to stand on end.
en_source: Besant 1922 (4th ed.) via en.wikisource [second-hand copy: Gita.AI]
en_swarupananda: Thus have I heard this wonderful dialogue between Vâsudeva and the high-souled Pârtha, causing my hair to stand on end.

speaker: sanjaya
sa:
व्यासप्रसादाच्छ्रुतवानेतद्गुह्यमहं परम् ।
योगं योगेश्वरात्कृष्णात्साक्षात्कथयतः स्वयम् ॥
iast_lib:
vyāsaprasādācchrutavānetadguhyamahaṃ param |
yogaṃ yogeśvarātkṛṣṇātsākṣātkathayataḥ svayam ||
en: By the favour of Vyâsa I listened to this secret and supreme yoga from the Lord of Yoga, Krishna Himself, speaking before mine eyes.
en_source: Besant 1922 (4th ed.) via en.wikisource [second-hand copy: Gita.AI]
en_swarupananda: Through the grace of Vyâsa have I heard this supreme and most profound Yoga, direct from Krishna, the Lord of Yoga, Himself declaring it.

speaker: sanjaya
sa:
राजन्संस्मृत्य संस्मृत्य संवादमिममद्भुतम् ।
केशवार्जुनयोः पुण्यं हृष्यामि च मुहुर्मुहुः ॥
iast_lib:
rājansaṃsmṛtya saṃsmṛtya saṃvādamimamadbhutam |
keśavārjunayoḥ puṇyaṃ hṛṣyāmi ca muhurmuhuḥ ||
en: O King, remembering, remembering this marvellous and holy dialogue between Keshava and Arjuna, I rejoice again and again.
en_source: Besant 1922 (4th ed.) via en.wikisource [second-hand copy: Gita.AI]
en_swarupananda: O King, as I remember and remember this wonderful and holy dialogue between Keshava and Arjuna, I rejoice again and again.

speaker: sanjaya
sa:
तच्च संस्मृत्य संस्मृत्य रूपमत्यद्भुतं हरेः ।
विस्मयो मे महान् राजन् हृष्यामि च पुनः पुनः ॥
sa_padas: विस्मयो मे महान् राजन् हृष्यामि च पुनः पुनः
iast_lib:
tacca saṃsmṛtya saṃsmṛtya rūpamatyadbhutaṃ hareḥ |
vismayo me mahān rājan hṛṣyāmi ca punaḥ punaḥ ||
en: Remembering, remembering, also that most marvellous form of Hari, great is my wonder, O King. I rejoice, again and again.
en_source: Besant 1922 (4th ed.) via en.wikisource [second-hand copy: Gita.AI]
en_swarupananda: And as I remember and remember that most wonderful Form of Hari, great is my wonder, O King; and I rejoice again and again.

speaker: sanjaya
sa:
यत्र योगेश्वरः कृष्णो यत्र पार्थो धनुर्धरः ।
तत्र श्रीर्विजयो भूतिर्ध्रुवा नीतिर्मतिर्मम ॥
sa_padas: यत्र योगेश्वरः कृष्णो यत्र पार्थो धनुर्धरः
iast_lib:
yatra yogeśvaraḥ kṛṣṇo yatra pārtho dhanurdharaḥ |
tatra śrīrvijayo bhūtirdhruvā nītirmatirmama ||
en: Wherever is Krishna, Yoga's Lord, wherever is Pârtha, the archer, assured are there prosperity, victory and happiness. So I think.
en_source: Besant 1922 (4th ed.) via en.wikisource [second-hand copy: Gita.AI]
en_swarupananda: Wherever is Krishna, the Lord of Yoga, wherever is Pârtha, the wielder of the bow, there are prosperity, victory, expansion, and sound policy: such is my conviction.
